description:
**Job Description**
 The APAC Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC) AML Investigations team is responsible for identification, investigations and recommendation of suspicious transactions. The team manages Mantas and/or manual escalations of cases consistent with the Global AML Standards, provides an initial assessment of potential Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing as well as other nefarious activity and recommends cases for escalation and further review or closure as false positives.
   

  

 The India GFCC team is responsible for implementing the firm's AML programme and the local regulatory requirements in India for the Corporate and Investment Banking businesses.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Compliance officer – Investigations – Associate in the GFCC AML Investigations team, you are required to support the India MLRO in transaction monitoring activities including reviewing the alerts and cases generated from bank's automated software and other offline sources, relating to JPMCB India businesses.
   

  

 You should be capable of demonstrating investigative abilities, prioritization skills and a willingness to tackle new and difficult challenges. In this role, you will leverage your knowledge of the banking system, common AML typologies in identifying suspicious activities timely while ensuring quality of work. In addition, you should be a team player who can collaborate with multiple stakeholders, possesses strong analytical skills and is adaptable and able to thrive in an evolving environment. To be successful, you should have a strong understanding of Corporate Banking, Commercial Banking, Foreign Correspondent Bank \- AML and Compliance knowledge, possesses the ability to exercise sound judgment and observe the highest degree of confidentiality in handling of information received in the course of the responsibilities.
   

  

 The role will involve working closely with the India GFCC team, regional AML investigation team and front line staff to ensure that the AML alerts are reviewed and disposed off as per the firm's policies and standards, as well as local laws and regulations.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Have the subject matter expertise of AML and/or Terrorist Financing investigations, including comprehensive understanding of AML processes, Technology, Case Management and products / services
* Have deep understanding of the Red Flag indicators relating to AML/CFT applicable to LOBs issued by local regulators as well as international best practices, specially non\-automated scenarios, including trade\-based money laundering.
* Ensure and manage the quality of investigations while managing SLA appropriately and timely
* Assess investigations and/or AML trends, including collaboration or partnership with regional or global stakeholders to effectively escalate, communicate, transfer information or implement change management
* Participate in AML Investigations or Line of Business initiatives, process improvements or enhancements, including the use of technology and support the India MLRO in determination of STRs.
* Gather, coordinate and participate in changes to the firm's AML policies / processes or AML trends with MLROs based on local regulations, relevant GFCC Functions, Compliance and/or Line of Business.
* Support the India GFCC team during any regulatory exams, primarily in responding to queries relating to transaction monitoring programme.
* Support the India MLRO in discharging the AML/KYC responsibilities for all regulated JPM India entities.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Statistical Mathematics, Data Science or equivalent/related disciplines
* 5 plus years of experience in the Financial Services Industry with a demonstrated track\-record experience and knowledge of Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, Foreign Correspondent Bank AML investigations, including proficient understanding of India AML/CFT regulations and requirements


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Experience in handling regulatory investigations an advantage


**Competencies**
* Ability to develop and maintain productive relationships with key internal clients across all levels.
* A solution driven approach, with exemplary problem solving skills;
* Good analytical ability.
* Ability to own, deep\-dive and/or investigate issues and can derive solutions independently, ultimately ensuring successful implementation or resolution
* Experienced with Mantas, technology driven case management tool and/or technology will be preferred and require proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint etc.), and the experience to handle large volumes of quantitative data
* Ability to work effectively alone and as part of a team, at a local and regional level
* Strong interpersonal or client management skills required to work effectively, influence and/or negotiate desired outcomes with multiple stakeholders and/or senior management
* Good written and verbal communication skills.


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.

This position affords the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to handle real\-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment.

You will lead complex investigations into potential policy breaches, partnering with Legal, Compliance, HR, and business leadership to ensure timely resolution. You will also enhance the Code of Ethics monitoring program by refining frameworks, strengthening policies, and leveraging data\-driven insights to support effective governance. You will assist in filing regulatory obligations which require complex quantitative and qualitative analysis of the firm’s data. Your role will involve developing new ideas, solutions, and structures, driving thought leadership, and making strategic choices to address system\-level enablers.  Shark Ninja is expanding our APAC business and scaling it rapidly. Our two brands, Shark, and Ninja, have enjoyed unprecedented growth in the past 5 years, driven mainly by the very strong innovation pipeline on both brands. Given this success in our existing markets, Shark Ninja has embarked on a bold plan for growing APAC business, in which India plays a critical role. We have taken over this market from our distributors, so that we can run them directly and drive strong growth, behind innovation and investments.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Legal Associate to join our team. This role will be based in Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented legal professional to join our Legal team. The role involves end\-to\-end legal support across contract management, regulatory tracking, legal research, policy drafting, and stakeholder coordination. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing legal assignments while partnering closely with global legal teams, commercial, product, and compliance teams to enable compliant and efficient business operations.
   

  

**Key Deliverables**
* Track and analyze regulatory developments and legal updates relevant to the organization and provide recommendations on potential business impact.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a broad range of commercial agreements, including Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), Supply Agreements, Vendor Agreements, Advertising Agreements, and other business contracts.
* Maintain and manage the company's contract repository, ensuring accurate record\-keeping, version control, and documentation governance.
* Partner closely with global legal and cross\-functional teams to ensure efficient and consistent delivery of legal support across jurisdictions.
* Manage statutory, corporate secretarial, and regulatory compliance requirements across jurisdictions, including maintaining an audit\-ready compliance calendar and supporting regulatory filings.
* Support the implementation and monitoring of data privacy practices and compliance with applicable data protection laws across the organization.
* Conduct legal research and provide practical guidance to business stakeholders on routine legal and compliance matters.
* Coordinate with external counsel, regulatory authorities, and internal stakeholders as required.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Bachelor of Law (LL.B) or equivalent legal qualification
* 2\-4 years of experience as a paralegal and/or other proven matter and contract management experience including contract review, drafting and negotiation.
* Excellent English communication skills, with prior experience working with in\-house legal teams across APAC.

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for an Associate Director to join our Legal and Compliance team, based out of the firm’s office in Hyderabad, India. The Legal team is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and resolving legal issues and risks for the firm. This position provides an opportunity to lead and grow within a high\-performing team within the Legal team. The team’s scope includes reviewing, drafting, and negotiating a wide range of international contracts, with a particular focus on agreements relating to intellectual property and trading, and encompassing agreements, such as NDA(s), event contracts, and other commercial arrangements. The team also handles data privacy matters, conducts compliance analyses, and provides paralegal support.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 In this role, you will lead, manage, and expand a sub\-team within the Legal department, playing a pivotal role in supporting the global legal and compliance function. You will also be required to have hands on involvement in drafting and negotiating IP and trading agreements, in addition to overseeing the broader contract portfolio. Additionally, you will work closely with stakeholders across global offices, with responsibility for strategically building the team’s capabilities and reach, which includes driving talent acquisition, development, and retention efforts, while providing mentorship, career guidance, and meaningful growth opportunities to team members. Furthermore, you will contribute to departmental initiatives and shape strategic priorities that impact the firm globally, along with reporting to the India General Counsel.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

**Basic qualifications:**
* A bachelor’s degree in law with approximately 12 years of relevant experience, including at least 6 years of leading large legal teams
* Proven leadership and strategic thinking skills, supported by experience in both law firms and multinational organizations
* Exceptional track record in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating diverse contracts, including license agreements, SaaS contracts, trading agreements (e.g., ISDA, GMRA, confirms, and repos), NDAs, and vendor agreements

* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capability to manage multiple priorities in a speedy environment

**Preferred qualifications:**
* A master’s degree in law

 The Legal Counsel will play a key role in supporting Maersk’s Global Customer Contracting Agenda by driving well\-governed, risk\-aware, and commercially strategic contract management processes. This role involves independently reviewing, negotiating, and finalizing complex maritime \-logistics, and commercial agreements, including those with key clients, while partnering closely with commercial account owners, product teams, and other key stakeholders. The position demands a comprehensive, business\-aligned approach to contract management—balancing customer expectations with legal protection and commercial priorities. The successful candidate will influence contract strategy, support stakeholder alignment, and contribute to continuous improvement in a dynamic, international environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Draft, review, and finalize complex maritime, logistics, and commercial agreements, including contracts with Key Clients.
* Lead contract negotiations with customers and external stakeholders, focusing on high\-value and complex agreements to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Own the legal contracting process for a region, partnering closely with relevant business stakeholders
* Lead stakeholder alignment calls and provides strategic input on contract design, playbooks, fallback positions, and negotiation strategy.
* Ensure compliance with legal policies and alignment with the organization’s strategic objectives, while mitigating legal risk exposure.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to obtain balanced outcomes that align legal protections with commercial priorities.
* Provide legal guidance on contractual risks and support the development of risk management strategies that align with business goals.
* Support the team manager in quality oversight, and supervision of new joiners.
* Mentor and act as a role model for junior team members to promote learning, consistent quality delivery and personal growth.
* Contribute expertise to legal department knowledge management initiatives, including the development of templates and best practice guidance.
* Stay abreast of legal, commercial, and industry trends, and support Legal’s strategic alignment with business developments.



  





**Required Experience \& Skills** 



* Educational degree in Law, i.e., a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, with substantial experience in contract review, drafting and negotiations. Advanced skills in working in a fast\-paced, international environment requiring strong analytical, communication and negotiation skills. Further, you:
* Have 8\+ years of experience in contract review, preferably in an international law firm or corporation.
* Possess strong contract negotiation skills and the ability to lead negotiations and handle complex agreements independently.
* Have strong working knowledge of international maritime and logistics law (preferred).
* Are highly proficient in MS Office and can manage multiple priorities with attention to detail.

description:
**Legal Counsel II** 




 Commercial Contracting, Privacy \& Product Compliance
 



  





 We build the identity verification and onboarding AI that banks, NBFCs, insurers, brokers, telcos and fintechs run their customers through, across India, the US, ASEAN and Africa. Hundreds of millions of verifications, in markets where a regulator is watching each one.
 



 Which means our legal team does not sit downstream of the product. Whether a feature can exist, where the data can live, how long we can keep it, what the model can learn from, those are legal questions before they are engineering questions. We are looking for a lawyer who wants to answer them.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As Legal Counsel II, you will own commercial contracting and compliance for HyperVerge’s identity AI business and HyperStart, our contract lifecycle management platform. You will be the day\-to\-day legal partner to Sales, Product, Security, Engineering, Finance and Strategy.
 



 The role is roughly two\-thirds contracting and privacy operations, one\-third regulatory and product counsel \- and the balance shifts toward the second as you build depth.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




**Commercial Contracting** 



* Run NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, order forms, DPAs, SLAs, security addenda and vendor agreements end to end \- with enterprise counterparties across India, the US, ASEAN and MEA.
* Negotiate directly with counterparty counsel, including large, regulated institutions with entrenched paper.
* Own the terms that decide deals: liability and indemnity, data ownership and AI model governance, audit and regulator inspection rights, sub\-processing, service levels, exit and transition.
* Sharpen the playbooks, fallback matrices and redline standards as you go, so the next deal moves faster than the last one.



**Regulatory \& Product Compliance** 



* Translate BFSI regulation into product guardrails \- RBI’s KYC Master Direction (including CKYC), RBI’s outsourcing of IT services framework, IRDAI’s outsourcing and cyber security norms, SEBI’s cyber resilience expectations and what each of them means for a technology service provider sitting inside a regulated entity’s supply chain.
* Advise Product and Engineering early, at design stage, on data residency, retention, consent architecture, cross\-border transfer and sub\-processing.
* Run DPDP implementation on the ground, and handle GDPR, CCPA and PDPA diligence from customers, their auditors and their regulators.
* Own the compliance artefacts that get scrutinized in a real audit: DPIAs, records of processing, incident response runbooks, vendor risk assessments, policy acknowledgment workflows and customer diligence dockets.



**AI Governance** 



* Work on questions that do not yet have settled answers and involve evolving regulation: including governance and design for compliance of obligations under the AI laws and regulatory guidance across India, VN, The Philippines, US and Nigeria.
* Build the positions the company will rely on and be able to defend them to a customer’s risk committee.



**Corporate, IP \& Open Source** 



* Support the Head of Legal on cross\-border corporate and entity work as we expand, intra\-group arrangements, employment and EOR structures in new markets, and coordination with external counsel on filings. Real exposure to how a multi\-jurisdiction structure gets built, without carrying it alone.
* Maintain trademark filings and brand protection; track open\-source usage and licensing obligations; escalate AI and IP issues that need deeper review.



**Legal Operations** 



* Own the legal intake queue and contracting pipeline; track and move the numbers on turnaround time.
* Automate the repeatable work. We run our own CLM and build our own AI\-assisted review tools, you will use them, stress\-test them, and tell us what to build next.



  





**What Great Looks Like** 




**First 90 days.** 
 Fluent on the product stack, the top enterprise contracts, the playbooks and the BFSI regulatory map. Closing standard and mid\-complexity deals independently. One real friction point in the contracting lifecycle found and fixed.
 



**By month six.** 
 Negotiating MSAs, DPAs and security addenda with regulated clients without supervision. At least one privacy or compliance workflow operationalized end to end. The person Sales, Product and Security call first.
 



**By year one.** 
 Owning a regulatory or product\-compliance domain outright, the person the company relies on for that answer, internally and in front of customers.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **3–5 years’ post\-qualification experience** 
 in technology specifically fintech or general corporate law \- in\-house or at a firm. In\-house exposure to a regulated or regulated\-adjacent business is a strong plus.
* **Hands\-on commercial SaaS contracting,** 
 including negotiating against BFSI counterparties and their procurement and risk teams.
* **A working understanding of the banking, insurance and broking ecosystem** 
 \- how these entities are regulated, and how those obligations flow down to their technology service providers.
* **Practical experience with privacy frameworks \- DPDP, GDPR or CCPA** 
 \- not just a reading of them.
* **A sound grasp of SaaS commercial models, IP and open\-source licensing.**
* **LL.B. required.** 
 LL.M. or a privacy certification (CIPP/E, CIPM or equivalent) is a plus, not a substitute for judgment.
* **Clear, plain\-English drafting** 
 and a calm, solution\-oriented negotiating style.



  





**You’ll Thrive Here If You** 



* Would rather understand how the product works than take the PM’s word for it.
* Are willing to give a reasoned answer in an area where the regulator has not given one yet, and to show your working.
* Escalate genuine edge cases early and unblock everything else yourself.
* Ask “how do I make this repeatable” the second time you do something.Want to build positions, processes, tools and not only review.



  





**How We Work** 



* An intentional small, high ownership legal team with real accountability.
* Direct access to founders, business heads and product leadership. Legal is in the room when decisions are made.
* We invest in legal technology and AI\-assisted workflows, and we expect our lawyers to work at the front of that curve.

**Job Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**GLOBAL COMPLIANCE AT GOLDMAN SACHS**
 At Goldman Sachs, the mandate of Global Compliance is to prevent, detect and mitigate compliance, regulatory, and reputational risk across the firm and help to strengthen the firm’s culture of compliance. Compliance accomplishes this mandate through the firm’s enterprise\-wide compliance risk management program. As an independent control function and part of the firm’s second line of defense, Compliance assesses the firm’s compliance, regulatory and reputational risk; monitors for compliance with new or amended laws, rules and regulations; designs and implements controls, policies, procedures and training; conducts independent testing; investigates, surveils and monitors for compliance risks and breaches; and leads the firm’s responses to regulatory examinations, audits and inquiries. Compliance provides advice on how to conduct the firm’s business in a manner that complies with the vast array of rules, regulations and regulatory expectations around the globe. Importantly, Compliance plays a key role in reviewing and effectively challenging transactions presenting compliance or reputational risks.
   

  

**Business Unit And Role Overview**
 Compliance provides compliance coverage to the Operations, Engineering, Controllers, Corporate Treasury, Corporate and Workplace Solutions, Executive Office, Corporate Planning Management, Risk, Tax and Human Capital Management divisions.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Conducting risk identification, measurement and assessment
* Monitoring for compliance with laws, rules, regulations and policies, including the identification and investigation of conduct related issues
* Participating in firm responses to regulatory examinations, audits and inquiries
* Performing surveillance and investigations of business activities of the above\-referenced divisions
* Testing the effectiveness of controls
* Writing policies and procedures
* Communicating regulatory requirements and firm policy expectations to educate others both one\-on\-one and through compliance learning initiative


**Responsibilities And Qualifications**
**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Responsibilities**
 As part of the India \- The Core Compliance team, you will provide compliance support and coverage for the firm’s Engineering Division, Risk Division and Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) team. You will also participate in region\-wide and global initiatives to enact the Global Compliance mandate and Business Unit priorities. To fulfill this role and responsibilities, you will need to:
   

  

* Advise, challenge, and influence the Engineering Division, Risk Division and TPRM team regarding financial regulation implementation, firmwide and divisional policies, and reputational risk
* Brief senior leadership on risks identified and ensure stakeholder engagement
* Analyze and conduct ongoing reviews of regulations, rule trends and enforcement actions to assess impact and identify potential gaps
* Partner with impacted groups to ensure the business can support new rules and requirements
* Identify, investigate, and manage compliance issues involving the Engineering Division, Risk Division and TPRM
* Coordinate with counterparts in other jurisdictions to ensure the firm is meeting related regulatory requirements globally
* As needed, support development and analysis of related policies, standards, and processes to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and requirements
* Recommend and undertake compliance testing and forensic investigatory work
* Develop and deliver communications and training
* Coordinate with the broader Compliance team on specific initiatives and projects


**Qualifications And Skills**
 A strong candidate for The Core Compliance will satisfy the following criteria:
   

  

* At least 7\-8 years of relevant work experience obtained as a compliance officer, regulator or in a risk management role
* Bachelor’s degree or higher. A graduate degree in a related area (law, risk, information security) is a plus
* Experience in reading and interpreting regulations, laws and statutes
* Understanding of the global regulatory environment as it relates to technology and information security
* Experience interacting with regulators, or supporting regulatory audits or inquiries is a plus


 A strong candidate for The Core Compliance will possess the following skills:
   

  

* Clear, concise communications skills; able to communicate with impact at senior levels
* Able and willing to challenge; comfortable with inter\-personal conflict; able to build strong professional rapport with stakeholders while maintaining independence as a risk manager
* Work independently. Exercise sound judgment, ethics and integrity
* Fast learner; able to adapt to business and regulatory changes; interest to challenge status quo and find new solutions
* Well organized with the ability to manage both longer term projects and daily, often time\-sensitive, escalations
* Proficient in using technology; able to analyze data sets and summarize findings; comfortable learning new technologies, both as a user and to identify risks
* Team\-oriented and supportive of others’ success; comfortable representing a team work product to stakeholders


**About Goldman Sachs**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world. We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal
   

  

 finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers. We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process.
   

  

 Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability\-statement.html

**Description**
 Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. Operating under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, RCS functions as the second line of defense, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.
   

  

 RCS's Mission Is To Leverage Specialist Industry Insights And Amazon's Unique Approach To Scale Through Technology, Delighting Customers Through Tailored Compliance Solutions. Our Work Spans Multiple Critical Areas, Including
   

  

* Enabling Amazon's financial services expansion through streamlined license acquisition
* Managing existing business risks across the organization
* Delivering comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
* Developing innovative solutions like Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
* Transforming compliance operations into a proactive, intelligence\-led framework


**Role Overview**
 We're seeking a talented Software Development Engineer II to build scalable technology solutions that transform how Amazon approaches compliance and risk management. This role is critical for RCS's mission to scale compliance operations through technology, reduce manual processes, and enable Amazon's global expansion while maintaining regulatory compliance.
   

  

 At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand.
   

  

 The challenges you'll solve are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Description**
 We are seeking a Tax Compliance Program Manager to support the First Line of Defense (1LoD) for EU/UK tax compliance across Amazon’s Marketplace business. In this role, you will execute against defined risk workstreams, support governance processes, and deliver control activities arising from EU and UK tax regulations. Working within established risk frameworks and under the guidance of senior programme leaders, you will contribute to ensuring the business operates within clearly defined risk appetite and compliance standards.
   

  

 You will support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax compliance risks across Amazon’s Global Selling ecosystem. This includes executing operational controls aligned to EU/UK regulatory requirements, maintaining risk documentation, tracking programme deliverables, and escalating emerging risks through appropriate channels. You will monitor regulatory developments and assess their operational implications, contributing analysis that informs programme\-level decisions.
   

  

 Your focus will be on maintaining preventative controls, supporting data integrity across tax and identity systems, and producing audit\-ready documentation. Working cross\-functionally with Legal, Policy, Product, Tax, and Data Science partners, you will execute against programme plans, support the resolution of systemic issues, and contribute to risk\-based control frameworks. You will ensure compliance activities within your workstreams are proportionate, risk\-calibrated, and delivered on time and to the expected quality bar.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own defined workstreams within EU and UK tax compliance programmes, delivering risk assessments and control activities on time and to quality standards
* Execute risk assessments using established methodologies, documenting findings clearly and escalating issues that exceed defined thresholds
* Analyze EU/UK tax compliance regulations (e.g., VAT, DAC7, JSL, Deemed Reseller) and their implications for Amazon sellers, translating requirements into actionable deliverables
* Support the development and maintenance of risk models and detection mechanisms to identify non\-compliant or fraudulent seller behaviour related to tax obligations
* Collaborate with legal, policy, finance, tax, tech, and product teams to execute programme plans and deliver operational controls for new and existing programmes
* Track key risk indicators (KRIs) and programme metrics, producing status reports and flagging deviations to programme leadership
* Prepare risk assessments, programme updates, and supporting materials for senior leadership reviews
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation and contribute to continuous improvement of risk and programme processes


 A day in the life
   

  

 You are joining a global team spread across the US, EU, Japan, and India. You will partner closely with a Tax Governance manager in the UK and collaborate heavily with Risk teams based in India and the EU to ensure Amazon’s compliance controls are in the best possible working order.
   

  

 Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross\-functional delivery, and stakeholder coordination across multiple time zones. One morning you are reviewing control effectiveness with the 2nd Line of Defence; the afternoon you are in a working session with EU 3P Marketplace partners assessing the impact of a new VAT regulation on sellers. The next day you are preparing materials for a senior leadership review or troubleshooting a data integrity issue with tech partners in Seattle.
   

  

 No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.

* Experience in compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent

* 2\+ years of program or project management experience

* Experience using lean process improvement, six sigma methodologies, or related performance metrics/process improvements to increase efficiency within processes, forecasting, planning, optimization, or logistics

description:
**Head of Anti\-Piracy \& Platform Partnerships**
**About the Role:**
 JioStar is India's leading media and entertainment business, home to JioHotstar (500M\+ monthly active users) and the exclusive home of the IPL (₹47,551 Cr rights value), ICC events and India's most\-watched entertainment. With piracy costing India's video sector an estimated $1\.2 billion annually, content protection is a key priority.
   

  

 This is a build\-and\-lead mandate. The function operates as a lean, intelligence\-led command centre. The Head of Anti\-Piracy \& Platform Partnerships will own operational strategy, platform governance, vendor management, law enforcement coordination and live\-event readiness across domestic and future international markets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Strategy \& Operations:**
* Own end\-to\-end execution of JioStar's anti\-piracy strategy across broadcast, OTT, IPTV, social media and emerging ecosystems.
* Define the function's operating model, KPIs and business\-impact metrics — moving beyond volume\-based takedown counts.
* Lead international expansion planning: jurisdictional scoping, coalition partnerships, and phased capability build\-out.


**Platform Partnerships \& Escalation:**
* Own senior relationships with Meta, Google/YouTube, Telegram, ISPs, hosting providers, registrars and CDNs.
* Lead escalation pathways for high\-priority takedowns, repeat\-offender action and live\-event enforcement.
* Represent JioStar in industry coalitions and platform trust \& safety forums (ACE, IBCAP, AAPA and equivalents).


**Live\-Event Anti\-Piracy Operations:**
* Command the live\-event anti\-piracy operation for IPL, ICC and premium events — 24/7 control\-room oversight, mobilization within hours.
* Establish playbooks for restream takedowns, app\-store enforcement and ISP\-level blocking during marquee fixtures.


**Intelligence, Investigations \& Vendor Governance:**
* Oversee the Intelligence \& Investigations and the Data, Automation \& Vendor Governance portfolio; ensure intelligence precedes every enforcement action.
* Govern the external vendor ecosystem: set SLAs, manage performance, rationalize the partner footprint and drive automation.


**Law Enforcement, Legal \& Regional Coordination:**
* Build senior relationships with national and state law enforcement, cyber cells, and MIB.
* Direct Regional Enforcement Coordinators on field operations, raids and state\-level piracy disruption.
* Partner with in\-house Legal on orders, dynamic injunctions, site\-blocking and criminal complaints.


**Executive Engagement:**
* Drive cross\-functional coordination with Business, Legal, Distribution, Content Operations and Technology.
* Deliver executive reporting on threat landscape, enforcement outcomes and business impact to senior leadership.


**Required Experience \& Capabilities:**
* 15\+ years in OTT, digital media, broadcasting or Trust \& Safety, with a meaningful share in content protection, anti\-piracy, fraud or platform integrity.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-stakeholder enforcement programs at scale across digital, broadcast and physical distribution.
* Direct engagement with Meta, Google/YouTube, Telegram, ISPs and hosting providers at a senior governance level.
* Deep, current understanding of digital piracy ecosystems — illegal IPTV networks, restream chains, Telegram piracy, cyberlockers and app\-based modalities.
* Intelligence orientation — approaches problems as an investigator, not an operator; comfortable with attribution analysis and OSINT outputs.
* Systems thinking, platform ecosystem fluency, operational maturity and strong stakeholder management at executive, regulatory and law\-enforcement levels.
* Live\-event content protection operations experience strongly preferred.


**Alternative Backgrounds Considered:**
*JioStar will actively consider Ex\-Armed Forces SSC officers (Indian Navy / Air Force) from Signals, Intelligence, Cyber or Information Warfare backgrounds with demonstrable platform\-ecosystem fluency.*

**EY\- GDS Consulting – Enterprise Risk (ER) – Regulatory Compliance –Senior (Veeva Vault QMS)**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 As part of our EY\-ER\- Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines \& methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance senior actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you’ll consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY is seeking a Senior Veeva Vault QMS Developer to support global life sciences clients in designing, configuring, and implementing Veeva Vault Quality Management Systems (QMS) in highly regulated environments. This role is ideal for professionals with deep Veeva Vault technical expertise, strong understanding of GxP compliance, and experience delivering validated, scalable QMS solutions.
   

  

 You will work closely with Quality, IT, Validation, and Business stakeholders to translate quality and compliance requirements into robust Vault configurations that align with global regulatory standards and client quality strategies.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Veeva Vault QMS Senior Developer, you will be responsible for configuring, customizing, and deploying Veeva Vault QMS modules, supporting integrations, and ensuring system compliance throughout the validation lifecycle. You will also provide technical leadership within projects and mentor junior resources.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Configure, customize, and deploy Veeva Vault QMS modules including Deviations, CAPA, Change Control, Audit Management, Quality Risk Management (QRM), Supplier Quality and Complaints, ensuring alignment with client\-specific quality processes and regulatory requirements.
* Design and implement workflows, object lifecycles, security roles, and page layouts and reports aligned with client quality processes to support scalable and compliant quality operations.
* Collaborate with Business, Quality, IT, and Validation teams to translate functional requirements into compliant Vault configurations
* Support data migration activities using Vault Loader and APIs, ensuring data integrity and traceability
* Design and support system integrations between Veeva Vault and enterprise systems (SAP, LIMS, MES, DMS, etc.)
* Author and maintain comprehensive system documentation, including configuration specifications, design documents, validation protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ), and user guides.

* Experience working with compliance monitoring platforms and compliance technology solutions.
* Knowledge of investment adviser regulatory requirements and securities compliance practices.
* Experience working in a client\-service\-oriented environment.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.

 : Associate Consultant\-TMT\-Business Consulting Risk\-CNS \- Risk \- Process \& Controls \- Mumbai
   

  

**TMT :**
 Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media \& Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
   

  

 We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise\-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M\&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.

Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
   

  

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
   

  

 Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
   

  

 Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

**Qualification**
* Not any specific, prior knowldge of production audit is must

description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Legal Manager to manage day\-to\-day legal, contractual and compliance matters supporting operations across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.
 



 The role requires a commercially practical lawyer who can independently manage contracts, legal research, documentation, compliance tracking, operational claims and coordination with external counsel.
 



  





 This is an individual\-contributor role with meaningful ownership. It is not a Head of Legal position, and jurisdiction\-specific UAE and Saudi legal opinions will be supported by qualified local counsel.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Commercial Contracts** 



* Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, NDAs, vendor agreements, technology agreements, service agreements, partnership agreements and other business contracts.
* Prepare and review agreements with operational partners, suppliers, corporate customers, dealerships, garages, insurers and other business partners.
* Review customer\-facing terms, subscription conditions, cancellation and refund policies, promotional terms and other consumer documentation.
* Identify contractual risks relating to liability, indemnity, insurance, data protection, intellectual property, termination, payment terms, service levels and dispute resolution.
* Maintain standard templates, fallback positions and practical negotiation playbooks for recurring agreements.



  





**Regulatory and Compliance Support** 



* Research and monitor laws and regulations relevant to business activities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.
* Support management in assessing regulatory requirements relating to mobility, transport, consumer protection, employment, outsourcing, digital services and data protection.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India, prepare clear instructions and convert external advice into actionable recommendations.
* Maintain a country\-wise compliance calendar, licence tracker, legal risk register and regulatory documentation repository.
* Support legal reviews for new services, partnerships, product features, market launches and operational changes.
* Assist with responses to regulators, authorities and formal legal notices in coordination with external counsel.



  





**Operational Claims and Disputes** 



* Support the handling of customer complaints, accidents, vehicle\-damage claims, insurance matters, partner breaches, employee disputes and other operational incidents.
* Review the relevant contracts, evidence, insurance position and potential liability before recommending a course of action.
* Draft and respond to legal notices, settlement correspondence, breach notices and other dispute\-related communications.
* Coordinate with operations, insurance providers, external counsel and other stakeholders to resolve matters efficiently.
* Maintain proper records of disputes, claims, settlements and ongoing legal exposure.



  





**Corporate and Employment Matters** 



* Support corporate governance requirements, including resolutions, signing authorities, corporate records, intercompany agreements and statutory documentation.
* Assist with employment agreements, confidentiality obligations, intellectual\-property assignments, employee policies, disciplinary matters and terminations.
* Support HR with workplace investigations and sensitive employee matters where legal review is required.
* Coordinate statutory and corporate compliance for India operations with company secretarial, tax and external legal advisers.



  





**Data Protection, Technology and Intellectual Property** 



* Review privacy policies, data\-processing agreements, technology contracts and vendor data\-protection terms.
* Support compliance relating to customer, employee and partner data, including location information, call recordings, identity documents and cross\-border data access.
* Coordinate with technology and information\-security teams on data incidents, vendor risk and privacy requirements.
* Protect intellectual property through appropriate contractual provisions, employee and contractor assignments, confidentiality controls and trademark coordination.



  





**Fundraising and Strategic Matters** 



* Support legal due diligence, document collection, data\-room management and responses to investor legal queries.
* Assist external counsel and management with financing documents, investment transactions, corporate restructuring and other strategic matters.
* Track post\-transaction obligations, approvals, reporting requirements and contractual commitments.



  





**Legal Operations** 



* Own the contract repository and ensure executed agreements, amendments and supporting documents are properly maintained.
* Track contract renewals, notice periods, expiry dates, commercial commitments and compliance obligations.
* Develop practical legal templates, internal policies, approval workflows and documentation standards.
* Maintain visibility on pending contracts, claims, legal notices, regulatory matters and external\-counsel assignments.
* Use appropriate contract\-management and productivity tools to improve turnaround time and reduce manual work.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Bachelor's degree in Law and enrolment with a recognised Bar Council in India.
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of post\-qualification legal experience.
* Meaningful in\-house experience, preferably within a startup, technology\-enabled business, marketplace, logistics, mobility, fintech or consumer\-services company.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts.
* Working knowledge of Indian corporate, commercial, employment, consumer and data\-protection laws.
* Exposure to operational disputes, insurance claims, customer complaints, employment matters or regulatory compliance.
* Experience supporting international or cross\-border business operations is preferred.
* UAE or Saudi legal exposure is advantageous but not mandatory.
* Ability to conduct structured legal research and work effectively with jurisdiction\-specific external counsel.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from manageable business risks.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly the ability to explain legal issues to non\-legal stakeholders.
* High attention to detail, strong ownership and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Comfort working closely with teams based in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Commercial contracts are completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Legal risks are identified early and communicated clearly.
* Agreements, renewals, claims and compliance obligations are properly tracked.
* External counsel is engaged efficiently and provided with clear, complete instructions.
* Management receives practical recommendations, not only summaries of the law.
* Legal processes become faster, more consistent and easier for business teams to use.

**Overview**
 The Senior Manager – R2P policy and Knowledge management will support the creation, governance, standardization, and continuous improvement of global Record\-to\-Pay (R2P) operational policies and decision frameworks and knowledge management to ensure consistent policy application, effective compliance, and operational excellence across Business Units and Sectors.
   

  

 In addition, the role owns the R2P knowledge management framework by maintaining standardized process documentation, policies, technology guidance, controls, and training materials.
   

  

 Purpose
   

  

* Support and maintain the R2P knowledge base, ensuring process documentation, policies, technology guidance, and controls remain current and aligned with business requirements.
* Support policy adoption and continuous improvement by leveraging monitoring insights, updating governance requirements
* Perform compliance monitoring activities, identify control gaps with respect to knowledge articles and other knowledge database, and track remediation actions to closure.
* Collaborate with Process Design, Operations (Service delivery), Knowledge Management teams to identify issues and remediation actions.


 Scope
   

  

* Support compliance to policy across business sectors
* Monitor adherence to approved R2P policies, controls, and procedures.
* Coordinate governance reporting, compliance reviews, and follow\-up of corrective actions.


**Responsibilities**
 Policy Governance
   

  

* Define, maintain, and periodically review global R2P operational policies and decision frameworks (e.g., Retro Purchase Orders, Bid Waiver Governance, Tactical Buying thresholds) in collaboration with Global Procurement and Sector leadership.
* Standardize policy implementation across Business Units and Sectors while governing approved exceptions, approval authorities, and escalation paths.
* Establish governance mechanisms to ensure policy consistency, transparency, and alignment with business objectives.
* Facilitate governance forums to review policy performance, exceptions, risks, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Monitor policy compliance through defined KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, and governance reporting.
* Identify policy deviations, recurring non\-compliance, and emerging risks through ongoing monitoring activities.
* Analyze compliance trends and recommend policy enhancements based on operational insights, business changes, and governance reviews.


 Knowledge Management
   

  

* Own and maintain the global R2P knowledge management framework, ensuring process documentation, SOPs, policies, technology guidance, and control documentation remain current and aligned to global standards.
* Proactively update knowledge content based on monitoring outcomes, policy revisions, process improvements, system enhancements, and governance decisions to ensure documentation reflects latest processes and tools
* Establish governance for document version control, periodic reviews, and knowledge repository maintenance.


 Training \& Change Management
   

  

* Partner with Change Management and functional stakeholders to develop and execute communication strategies supporting policy and process changes.
* Coordinate development and maintenance of R2P training materials and governance documentation.
* Drive awareness and adoption of new policies, governance requirements, and process changes through structured communication and training initiatives.
* Support organizational readiness activities to ensure successful implementation of governance initiatives.


 Governance of Training Materials
   

  

* Coordinate the maintenance and periodic review of R2P training materials to ensure they are accurate, up to date, and readily available to relevant teams.
* Collaborate with functional teams to update training guides and process documentation, ensuring learning materials reflect current processes and governance requirements.
* Collaborate with Process Design teams to define policies and BU control teams to implement the changes across business units.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or Supply chain management
* Minimum 8–10 years of progressive experience in Procurement, Source\-to\-Pay (S2P), Record\-to\-Pay (R2P), Shared Services, Governance, Internal Controls, Risk Management, or Compliance.
* Good understanding of R2P and AP processes with experience working on ERP and procurement platforms (e.g., Ariba, ServiceNow)
* Experience in compliance monitoring, governance reporting, KPI development, SLA management, and issue remediation.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and global stakeholders, including Operations (Service Delivery), BU Procurement, Finance, IT, and Process Design teams, Control teams (ICON/GCC/BU)
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, coordinate, and build effective working relationships across functions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high\-quality outcomes within tight deadlines.

As Senior Contracts Manager, you will provide strategic and commercially focused legal support across Bell’s operational, sales, pre\-sales, procurement, and senior management teams. You will ensure the business operates within a robust legal framework whilst supporting the achievement of its commercial objectives and driving revenue enablement, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency through best\-in\-class contracting practices.Working collaboratively across departments, you will deliver efficient, pragmatic, and commercially focused contract support, whilst also working closely with senior executives and coaching mentoring and developing junior members of the commercial contracts team.
   

  

* Lead the provision of clear, strategic, and commercially minded advice on complex contract terms, legal matters, and business risk across multiple areas of the business.
* Take ownership of reviewing, drafting, and negotiating a broad and complex range of agreements, including high\-value supplier and customer contracts, software licences, SaaS agreements, agency, reseller, subcontractor and service provision arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers and suppliers on complex or high\-value matters, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring outcomes align with business objectives, company policies, and risk appetite.
* Oversees and continuously improves Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), including contract registers, obligation tracking, renewals, amendments, and system optimisation, ensuring accuracy, accessibility, and compliance across the business.
* Act as a senior point of escalation for internal teams, providing guidance and support on complex on\-boarding, contractual disputes, claims, and legal risk matters.
* Monitor, interpret, and proactively communicate relevant legal and regulatory developments, assessing their impact on the business and recommending appropriate action (including data protection and other applicable regulatory frameworks).
* Engage, instruct, and strategically manage external legal counsel within agreed budgets, including oversight of matters involving Indian and other international jurisdictions, as well as specialist areas of law.
* Own and govern the business's suite of legal templates, driving regular reviews to ensure they remain current, commercially appropriate, and legally sound.
* Lead the identification and implementation of improvements to legal team processes, ways of working, and internal tools, including legal technology and automation solutions, to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Provide regular data\-driven reporting and insights to senior leadership on legal risk, workload, contract lifecycle metrics (e.g. cycle time, deviation rates) and matters of strategic relevance to the business.
* Support the development of less experienced team members, sharing knowledge and providing guidance to build capability within the legal function through coaching and mentorship.
* Ensure full compliance with all processes and procedures adopted by the team and the wider business and contribute to their ongoing development whilst championing a culture of consistent, compliant, and risk\-aware contracting.
* Act as the dedicated Legal Business Partner to an assigned business practice, developing a deep understanding of its strategy, commercial objectives, operating model, and risk profile.
* Act as the primary legal point of contact for strategic initiatives, deals, and projects within the assigned practice, ensuring effective alignment between legal, commercial, and operational objectives.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders within the assigned practice, proactively identifying legal needs and providing tailored, commercially focused guidance.
* Anticipate and support the evolving legal requirements of the business practice, ensuring timely and pragmatic advice aligned with its growth plans and operational priorities.
* Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard form documentation, templates, playbooks, and guidance specific to the needs of the assigned business practice, ensuring consistency, scalability, and risk alignment.
* Legal qualification, legal training, or significant contract management experience demonstrating a strong understanding of fundamental legal and commercial principles, including contract law. Knowledge of Indian contract law and experience working with contracts governed by English law or other international legal frameworks is desirable.
* Minimum of seven (7\) years' experience in a contract management or commercial contracts role, with significant experience within the technology sector or a systems integration environment. Strong knowledge of data protection, privacy, and information security principles, including experience with applicable privacy laws and regulatory frameworks such as the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), GDPR/UK GDPR, and other relevant international data protection requirements.
* Demonstrated expertise in independently leading and concluding complex, high\-value commercial negotiations across a range of agreement types.
* Substantial experience managing cross\-border agreements and navigating the legal and regulatory complexities of international contracting.
* A track record of working at a senior level alongside Sales, Procurement, Compliance, and operational teams to deliver commercially sound legal outcomes.
* Extensive experience negotiating key commercial risk provisions, including limitation of liability, indemnities, service levels, and data\-related risks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex legal matters clearly and confidently to senior stakeholders and non\-legal audiences.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office 365, with experience of contract management systems and tools.

description:
A global bank standing up its India technology and operations centre has reached a size where the centre needs its own governance rhythm rather than borrowing the parent entity's, and Flexiple, a managed marketplace placing specialist talent inside global companies' India teams, has been asked to help hire the person who will build it.
 



**Governance for a centre finding its own footing** 




 You would support the India centre's local board and governance committees end to end: preparing agendas and board packs, drafting minutes and resolutions, maintaining statutory registers, and coordinating the filings the centre owes to the Registrar of Companies and other authorities. You would also track compliance with the Companies Act and applicable Reserve Bank of India governance requirements for the centre's legal entity, and work with the global governance team to make sure local reporting lines up with what the parent entity expects.
 



**Where the gaps currently sit** 



* Board pack preparation is done ad hoc by whoever has time, with no fixed template or timeline
* Statutory registers have not been consistently updated as the centre has grown
* There is no single person accountable for the centre's Companies Act compliance calendar



**The profile we are hiring for** 



* 3 to 7 years in corporate governance or company secretarial work, ideally at a bank, financial\-services company, or large corporate
* A Company Secretary qualification, or an LLB with hands\-on governance and secretarial experience
* Working knowledge of Companies Act requirements and ROC filing processes
* Comfort setting up process where none currently exists, and working with both local and global stakeholders



 Location: Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad — hybrid, based alongside the centre's leadership and legal team
 



 Expect an HR screening, a working round on a governance\-calendar exercise, and a closing round with centre leadership.
 



 Flexiple keeps this application active for this role and future governance openings that fit your background.

* Lead and manage CLM Operations teams to deliver high\-quality, timely, and risk\-controlled support to Client Management and Business stakeholders across supported markets.
* Drive operational excellence by ensuring service levels, productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and client outcomes are consistently achieved while fostering a strong risk and control culture.
* Enable continuous improvement through stakeholder collaboration, process simplification, talent development, and adoption of digital and automation solutions that improve efficiency and client experience.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Leadership \& Team Management**
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing CLM Operations team, fostering engagement, capability building, succession planning, and a culture of accountability and continuous learning.


**Service Delivery \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure timely, accurate, and efficient delivery of operational activities in accordance with agreed service levels, quality standards, productivity targets, and client expectations.
* Drive operational excellence through effective capacity planning, workload management, resource optimisation, and continuous process improvement initiatives.


**Risk, Controls \& Governance**
* Maintain a robust risk and control environment by ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies, operational risk frameworks, and audit standards.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks, issues, and control gaps, ensuring appropriate remediation and sustainable solutions.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
* Build strong partnerships with Client Management, Business, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Technology, and other stakeholders to support business priorities and improve client experience.
* Influence and collaborate across teams to resolve complex issues, remove process bottlenecks, and drive successful delivery of business outcomes.


**Transformation \& Change**
* Lead and support change initiatives, automation opportunities, and process transformations that improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance service performance.


**Performance Management**
* Utilize management information, performance metrics, and data\-driven insights to monitor outcomes, support decision\-making, and deliver sustainable operational improvements.


**People and Talent**
* Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
* Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
* Lead by example by role\-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.


**Skills And Experience**
**Must\-have Skills**
* Team Leadership
* Client Lifecycle Management (CLM) / KYC Operations
* Risk \& Control Management


**Other Skills**
* Stakeholder Management \& Influencing
* Process Improvement \& Transformation
* Data Analytics \& MIS Management
* Change Management \& Automation Adoption


**Motivations**
* Driving operational excellence by solving complex business challenges, improving client outcomes, and delivering sustainable performance improvements.
* Leading and developing high\-performing teams, creating an inclusive environment where individuals can grow, collaborate, and achieve their full potential.
* Identifying opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls, leverage automation, and deliver meaningful change that improves efficiency, risk management, and stakeholder experience.
* These motivations align well with the role's focus on team leadership, continuous improvement, risk management, client service, and transformation within CLM Operations.


**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**
* Experience leading or supporting teams in a complex operations, financial services, client service or regulated environment.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver against service, quality, productivity and risk objectives.
* Experience managing operational risks, controls, escalations and audit or assurance requirements.
* Proven ability to collaborate with and influence diverse stakeholders across business, operations, risk, compliance and technology.
* Experience using management information and performance data to identify trends, support decisions and improve outcomes.
* Demonstrated success in leading change, process improvement, automation or operational simplification.
* Experience coaching and developing colleagues, strengthening team capability and supporting succession or workforce planning.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex matters clearly to senior stakeholders


**Certifications / Qualifications**
* No specific professional certification is mandatory, unless required by applicable local regulatory, compliance or role\-specific requirements.
* Relevant academic, professional or vocational learning in operations, banking, risk, compliance, leadership or a related field would be advantageous but is not essential.


**Languages**
* Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly with colleagues and stakeholders across different markets.


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
***Key Responsibilities***
* Maintain and continuously improve the compliance control set, the supporting evidence and the documentation required by regulatory and audit obligations (GDPR,NIS2, SAP security audits, SWIFT and GITC), covering:


 Ø Application change management and software development life cycle controls
   

  

 Ø Security hardening and vulnerability patching of operating systems and databases
   

  

 Ø IT user access permissions and periodic user access reviews
   

  

 Ø General user access — security audit logs, monitoring evidence and review
   

  

 Ø Privileged user access (ie Firefighter usage) and privileged activity review
   

  

 Ø Governance and review of operating systems and databases privileged access
   

  

 Ø Password policies and baseline identity controls (SSO/MFA principles)
   

  

 Ø Software compliance and security — web vulnerability management
   

  

 Ø SWIFT Customer Security Programme (CSP) compliance
   

  

* Run the day\-to\-day operation of the global security awareness programme: plan and launch phishing simulations and training campaigns, follow up completion, and report on results


 Ø Track training completion and phishing click/report rates, and propose improvements to campaign content, targeting and follow\-up
   

  

* Collaborate with the SAP Basis Security \& Authorization team to review and report SoD violations
* Coordinate the global vulnerability management process: consolidate scan results, prioritise on risk, track remediation with infrastructure, application and OT owners,and escalate overdue or high\-risk items
* Prepare the monthly, quarterly and annual compliance, vulnerability and awareness reports for the Global Security \& Compliance Manager and for Carmeuse IT leadership
* Support internal and external audits (including GITC): prepare evidence packs, coordinate control owners, support walkthroughs, and track findings through to closure
* Maintain the security governance documentation (policies, standards, procedures, control narratives and the exception register) and participate in ITSC and cyber security team meetings
* Ensure that Carmeuse's regulatory and audit compliance controls are secure and auditable, in
* line with the established security, audit and regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, SAP security audits, SWIFT and GITC)
* Operate the global security awareness and vulnerability management follow\-up processes, driving measurable improvement in employee behaviour and remediation performance
* Maintain the compliance documentation, metrics and reporting used by the Global Security \& Compliance Manager and by IT leadership


**Key performance indicators :**
 Compliance and audit findings closed on time; vulnerability remediation
   

  

 performance against the agreed SLAs (critical / high); security awareness results (training completion rate, phishing simulation click and report rates); timeliness and quality of the compliance evidence, metrics and reporting.
   

  

**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering / technology in Information Security, Computer Science, IT or a related field
* At least 8 years of experience in IT or cyber security, with hands\-on exposure to compliance, audit support and reporting (a GRC or internal audit background is an advantage)
* Working knowledge of regulatory and audit frameworks (GDPR, NIS2, SAP security audits, SWIFT,GITC);
* Mandatory certification: CISA
* ISO 27001 or CIPM are a plus
* Language: English (written \& spoken)
* Cyber security governance, control frameworks and audit evidence expectations
* Regulatory and industry compliance topics: GDPR, NIS2, SAP security audits and SWIFT
* compliance
* User access, Segregation of Duties and identity and access fundamentals (SSO/MFA principles)
* Vulnerability management principles (risk\-based prioritisation, remediation lifecycle, reporting)
* and security awareness platforms such as KnowBe4


**Skills**
* Problem solving, with attention to detail in controls, evidence and documentation
* Written and oral communication skills — able to explain technical topics to non\-technical stakeholders
* Organization \& planning — able to track many actions through to closure and hold a reporting cadence
* Microsoft desktop applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and compliance reporting/dashboarding
* Cross\-functional collaboration with IT, OT, Legal \& Privacy and business owners; pragmatic and outcome\-focused
