* At Enovis™ we pay attention to the details. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients and take pride in the pursuit of scientific excellence — with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it.


 Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.
   

  

 As a key member of the team, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward by transforming patient care and improving patient outcomes.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Regulatory Market Access Specialist
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Regulatory Market Access Specialist will work in the market access team to bring new and modified medical devices to market and ensure ongoing compliance. The Regulatory Market Access Specialist provides hands\-on regulatory affairs support for new product marketing approvals and renewals for existing products, including development of regulatory requirements and preparation of submissions. The Regulatory Market Access Specialist performs regulatory submission/approval activities for specific Enovis products. The Regulatory Market Access Specialist ensures compliance with required regulations and established corporate standards. The Regulatory Market Access Specialist ensures that product approvals are properly maintained, and product re\-registrations are properly managed. The Regulatory Market Access Specialist will exercise creativity/innovation with expectations of independent research and use of accepted regulatory practices in the execution of tasks.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Handles the preparation and processing of documentation required for new product introductions and modified products in international markets.
* Acts as a core team member on sustaining and new product development projects, providing regulatory feedback and guidance throughout the product development cycle.
* Works with market access team and cross\-functional peers to resolve potential regulatory/technical issues and questions from the regulatory agencies in international markets.
* Prepare documentation for international regulatory registrations and licenses
* Define regulatory requirements necessary for regulatory approval of Surgical for the countries under his/her responsibility
* Manages the release and shipment of products under regulatory controls to all regions.
* Provides recommendations for how to overcome regulatory barriers and resolve any disputes within teams as to the importance of regulatory requirements.
* Coordinates and assists the Market Access Lead with defining regulatory requirements in Regulatory planning process.
* Reviews and approves design and manufacturing changes for existing products, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and sends applicable notifications to license and registration holders in international markets.
* Maintain all regulatory documentation to ensure availability for external audits and preparation of submission packages
* Provides technical guidance and regulatory training to cross\-functional teams.
* Reviews device labeling and advertising materials for compliance with applicable regulations and recommends appropriate changes.
* Monitor the development of new regulatory requirements and advise of the impact to cross\-functional teams.
* Develops and maintains procedures to ensure compliance and support business goals.
* Maintains proficiency in government regulations and guidances.
* Support other regulatory requests or projects as needed.
* 


  

  

**Preferred Qualifications** 
  

  

* Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 2 years of medical device industry experience as a Regulatory Specialist
* Prior experience with regulatory submissions for medical devices in European and international markets
* General understanding of the product development process and design controls
* Ability to manage several projects simultaneously
* Strong interpersonal and influencing skills
* Ability to independently manage projects, prioritize time and communicate effectively
* Excellent command of English (spoken and written).

description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** 
 It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
   

  

**The Team:**
**The Opportunity:**
**What Your Impact Will Be**
**Job Title** 
**Audit Specialist – License Analyst Vendor Management**
**Location** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Job Summary** 
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Audit Specialist – License Analyst** 
 who serves as the organization’s subject matter expert in managing and responding to external and internal software license audits. This role is central to ensuring audit readiness, supporting vendor audits, and interpreting complex licensing models and entitlements. The ideal candidate brings deep understanding of the software audit landscape, risk exposure analysis, and vendor compliance enforcement. This position will partner closely with procurement, legal, IT, and finance teams to maintain audit controls and support enterprise compliance with license agreements. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Audit Response \& Management:**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for software and vendor license audits initiated by third\-party vendors or auditors.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (IT, procurement, legal, finance) to gather required data, documents, and evidence for audits.
* Interpret requests from auditors and ensure timely, complete, and accurate responses while protecting the organization’s interests.
* Manage audit timelines and ensure audit activities are conducted efficiently and within legal and contractual boundaries.


**Audit Landscape \& Risk Profiling:**
* Maintain a current audit landscape profile of high\-risk vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe) and their audit practices.
* Develop and maintain an audit risk matrix based on vendor contract terms, license models, and past audit history.
* Identify vendors with potential audit exposure and proactively engage stakeholders to mitigate risk.


**Licensing Compliance Analysis:**
* Analyze software entitlements, deployment data, and actual usage across environments (on\-premise, cloud, hybrid).
* Compare usage vs. entitlement to identify under\-licensing, over\-licensing, or misaligned deployments.
* Provide licensing expertise and interpretations of complex licensing models (SaaS, perpetual, subscription, consumption\-based).


**Documentation \& Controls:**
* Maintain audit documentation libraries including vendor correspondence, contract terms, deployment evidence, and audit reports.
* Develop and improve audit response templates, checklists, and workflows to ensure consistent and defensible audit responses.
* Support the creation and maintenance of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for audit handling and software license control.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Reporting:**
* Partner with internal stakeholders to explain audit findings, recommend corrective actions, and support remediation.
* Deliver periodic reports and dashboards on audit status, exposure, and trends to executive leadership and compliance committees.
* Provide advisory support during contract renewals or renegotiations to address past audit issues and future compliance planning.


**Audit Preparedness \& Education:**
* Lead internal mock audits or dry runs to evaluate readiness for upcoming vendor audits.
* Conduct awareness sessions and training for IT and procurement stakeholders on license audit risks and mitigation strategies.
* Recommend tools, practices, and governance frameworks to support ongoing license compliance.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Qualifications


**Education \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
* 4–7 years of experience in software license compliance, audit management, or software asset management (SAM).
* Proven experience handling third\-party software audits from vendors such as Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, etc.
* Experience in a Vendor Management Office or working with procurement/legal/IT on licensing matters is highly desirable.
* Skills \& Knowledge
* Strong understanding of software licensing models (perpetual, SaaS, subscription, user/device\-based, cloud usage).
* Familiarity with contract language related to licensing and audit rights.
* Working knowledge of audit processes, risk management, and compliance frameworks.
* High attention to detail in interpreting licensing terms, product use rights (PURs), and deployment metrics.
* Strong project management, coordination, and documentation skills.
* Tools \& Systems

title: Windows and Linux Compliance SME
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title: Windows \& Linux Compliance SME**
**Job Summary:**
 The MSFT Windows Compliance SME supports the Stay in Compliance Lead by managing compliance, risk and control activities across the global on\-premises Windows Server estate. The role provides deep technical expertise for Microsoft Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025, Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell Desired State Configuration, server hardware, virtualisation and associated hybrid\-cloud management capabilities. The role helps maintain a secure, supported and consistently configured estate through vulnerability remediation, security hardening, patch and version currency, configuration baselines, identity and access controls, automation, hardware lifecycle management and audit assurance.
   

  

 Working with On\-Prem Hosting Engineering and Operations, Information Security, Active Directory, Service Management, hardware, virtualisation, cloud and application teams, the role assesses security findings and configuration drift, engineers and coordinates large\-scale remediation, and produces traceable governance and audit reporting. The position provides Windows\-specific subject\-matter expertise and clear escalation to the Stay in Compliance Lead, while coordinating cross\-platform dependencies where Windows services interact with Linux, Azure, AWS, VMware, Nutanix AHV or Hyper\-V environments.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Serve as the compliance SME for the global on\-premises Microsoft Windows Server estate, supporting environments at enterprise scale, including estates exceeding 10,000 servers.
* Monitor Microsoft security advisories, vulnerability findings, operating\-system alerts, configuration data and vendor notifications to identify exposure affecting Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025\.
* Assess technical impact, affected versions, exploitability, business criticality, service dependencies and compensating controls, and support risk\-based prioritisation in line with agreed standards and remediation SLAs.
* Engineer, package, test and coordinate large\-scale remediation for security vulnerabilities, configuration changes and software updates using Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell, Desired State Configuration and Ansible.
* Design, implement and maintain Group Policy Objects and verify consistent application across relevant Active Directory forests and domains.
* Create and maintain security configuration items, baselines, compliance rules and automated corrective controls using PowerShell DSC and approved enterprise tooling.
* Plan and schedule deployment waves for patches, security configurations, GPO changes, software packages, firmware and drivers, balancing remediation urgency with production stability.
* Maintain compliance visibility across physical and virtual Windows servers hosted on VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV and Hyper\-V, including hardware, firmware, drivers, operating\-system versions and support lifecycle.
* Support secure account and access management for Windows servers, including privileged access, service accounts, local administrator controls, authentication policy and role separation.
* Perform security and performance analysis and recommend hardening, tuning and configuration changes for mission\-critical production systems in data\-centre environments.
* Support hybrid management of on\-premises servers through Microsoft Azure capabilities, including Azure Arc\-enabled servers, Azure Policy, machine configuration, monitoring and update\-management concepts where adopted.
* Coordinate cross\-platform remediation dependencies with Linux teams using Red Hat Satellite and Ansible Automation Platform when shared services, automation or controls span Windows and Linux environments.
* Prepare implementation plans, technical procedures, validation steps, rollback plans, change records and stakeholder communications for compliance deployments.
* Track remediation actions, ageing, exceptions, deployment failures, dependencies and closure evidence, escalating material risk or delivery delays to the Stay in Compliance Lead.
* Maintain accurate compliance records covering server inventory, patch and configuration status, GPO application, software and firmware currency, lifecycle, vulnerabilities, ownership, approved exceptions and evidence.
* Use ServiceNow, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Power BI, Dell OpenManage Enterprise, monitoring platforms, SharePoint, scripts and APIs to analyse compliance, automate recurring tasks and produce dashboards and reports.
* Support internal and external audits by providing timely, complete and traceable Windows Server configuration, access, patching, lifecycle and remediation evidence.
* Identify opportunities to standardise and automate vulnerability assessment, packaging, deployment, compliance validation, evidence collection and reporting using DevOps and infrastructure\-as\-code practices.
* Build effective working relationships across Engineering, Operations, Information Security, Service Management, Active Directory, Linux, cloud, virtualisation, hardware and application teams while operating within the governance direction set by the Stay in Compliance Lead.


**Knowledge \& Competencies Required:**
* Advanced hands\-on administration and compliance experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025 in large, globally distributed production environments.
* Expert knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy design and management, domain and forest structures, authentication, service accounts and privileged\-access controls.
* Proven experience assessing security risk, remediating Windows Server vulnerabilities, applying security baselines and tuning systems securely without compromising service availability.
* Deep scripting and automation capability in PowerShell, WMI and Python; experience with Ansible is required, while VBS and Perl knowledge is beneficial for legacy environments.
* Strong experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager and packaging and deploying software, scripts, updates and remediation controls at enterprise scale.
* Experience creating configuration items, security baselines and desired\-state controls using PowerShell DSC or equivalent configuration\-as\-code capabilities.
* Ability to interpret Microsoft security advisories, CVEs, severity scores, vulnerability scan findings, support lifecycle information and technical prerequisites and translate them into deployment actions.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server hardware management, firmware and driver currency, remote management and lifecycle controls; Dell OpenManage Enterprise experience is advantageous.
* Good knowledge of VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV and Hyper\-V virtualisation and the operational dependencies between guest operating systems and hosting platforms.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and hybrid\-cloud management, including Azure Arc\-enabled servers, Azure Policy, machine configuration, monitoring and update\-management concepts; AWS familiarity is beneficial.
* Working knowledge of Linux security and administration, Red Hat Satellite and Ansible Automation Platform sufficient to coordinate shared compliance and automation dependencies.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Power BI, SharePoint, monitoring and systems\-management platforms for remediation tracking, data analysis, dashboarding and audit reporting.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL, Agile, Kanban, Scrum and DevOps practices, particularly Change, Incident, Problem, Risk and Release Management.
* Ability to create clear technical documentation, procedures, implementation plans, rollback instructions, validation evidence and management reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a disciplined approach to risk, data quality, control traceability and production stability.
* Clear communication, stakeholder coordination and influencing skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively across global, geographically dispersed teams.


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
   

  

**Experience:**
 Seven to eight years of relevant experience in enterprise Windows Server engineering, systems administration, infrastructure security or compliance, including substantial hands\-on experience with Active Directory and GPO, Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell automation, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, hardware lifecycle and mission\-critical data\-centre systems. Experience operating at large scale and coordinating complex global deployments is required.
   

  

**Certification Requirements:**
 ITIL Foundation certification is required. Current Microsoft Windows Server, Azure Administrator, Azure Fundamentals or Microsoft security certifications are preferred. Red Hat, Linux Foundation, Ansible, VMware, Nutanix or CISSP certifications are beneficial. Legacy MCSA or MCSE Windows Server certification will be recognised where held.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Head of Legal
description:
**Head of Legal** 




  





 Legal here is a profit function, not a review desk — and you're the one who prices it that way. The paper prices value, wins faster, and protects the assets that compound: outcome contracts, partner paper, marketplace terms, IP architecture, and your own Locked numbers.
 



  





**What are we looking for** 




  





**Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind.** 
 Contracting, done right, isn't a defense function — it's how value gets priced, protected, and compounded. If you read a deal the way an architect reads a structure — where the risk sits, where the margin sits, and how to build paper that holds under both negotiation and audit — we want to connect.
 



  




* Principal, not custodian.
* Reads risk the way an engineer reads load\-bearing steel.
* Builds the paper once, so it holds — not the paper you redraft every time someone pushes back.
* Comfortable being the last signature before something becomes real.
* Thinks in systems: this clause, this precedent, this margin, for years — not just this deal.



  





**This Isn’t for Everyone.** 
 But if you’ve ever redlined a contract and thought about the deal it
 *should* 
 have been — not just the risk it should have avoided — we’d love to chat with you.
 



  





**Your Mission: The Role** 




*solving for better.* 




  





 This firm sells outcome contracts — fixed, at\-risk, and gainshare against verified numbers. It admits partners on profit points, lists products on CSP marketplaces, and deploys engineers into partner programs on tour terms. Every one of those is a contracting innovation, and each one either generates margin or blocks it. The paper is the pricing instrument. You own the paper.
 



 You build the function from an empty seat: three people, live in six months, chartered like every other squad here — a Locked number, an eval discipline, agents as the workforce, humans on judgment. If your instinct is to steer an outcome fee back to time\-and\-materials, or to say no before you've priced the yes, this isn't your seat.
 



 If you read a P\&L as fluently as a clause, treat a term sheet as a pricing instrument, and don't lose energy in a hostile counterparty round — this is your seat at the table.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities** 




*what you will wake up to solve.* 




  





**Price the Value** 



* **Own the Outcome Paper:** 
 Structure fixed, at\-risk, and gainshare contracts against verified numbers — every clause a pricing instrument, not boilerplate. Gainshare converts delivery excellence into revenue that hourly paper never captures.
* **Clear the Marketplace:** 
 Get listing terms cleared on both CSP marketplaces so commit\-burn purchasing becomes procurement\-free revenue. Paper that isn't cleared is revenue that doesn't exist.
* **Write the Moat's Legal Layer:** 
 Partnership deeds, vesting, and clawback mechanics validated across India, the US, the UK, and Singapore; an IP and two\-brand trademark architecture that protects the patterns and agents that compound.
* **Cut the Cycle:** 
 Every day removed from paper cycles is pipeline conversion. NDA turnaround under 24 hours; MSA and SOW under 5 days — by month 6\.



**Build the Agentic Function** 



* **Agents Draft First, Always:** 
 Stand up drafting agents grounded in a versioned clause library so no contract starts from a blank page; humans redline and decide. 80% of routine paper agent\-first\-drafted by month 6\.
* **Playbooks as Code:** 
 Codify negotiation positions, fallback ladders, and escalation thresholds per contract type. Review agents enforce them; only deviations reach a human.
* **Run the Eval Harness:** 
 A gold\-standard contract set with known issues; every agent measured on catch rate and false\-positive rate per clause type before deployment and on every model refresh. Legal is not exempt from evaluation.
* **Hire Above Your Own Bar:** 
 Hire the talent required to achieve the function's objectives — a three\-person team, not a growing headcount. Make self\-serve standard paper cover 50% of requests so hiring above the bar, not adding more of it, is how you scale.



**Hold the Judgment Line** 



* **Human\-Only Gates, Non\-Negotiable:** 
 Signatures, novel structures, regulatory filings, disputes, and anything touching the verification instrument or partner admission stay with you. Zero agent\-drafted paper is signed without human review.
* **Zero Ambiguity Restatements:** 
 No verified\-number restatement is ever traceable to contract ambiguity. The paper is precise enough that the number holds.
* **Buy Depth, Don't Hire It:** 
 Run outside counsel across the US, UK, Singapore, and the Middle East as an elastic layer, bought per matter and managed against a spend\-per\-matter number — down 40% against the month\-1 baseline.



**Report a Number, Not a Cost Line** 



* **Legal's Own Ledger:** 
 Report a revenue\-enabled number to the Betting Table — contract\-cycle days removed from pursuits, gainshare clauses executed, marketplace revenue unlocked — not only a spend line.
* **Own Every Locked Number:** 
 You are accountable for each target above and for the human\-only gates. Not the team. You.



  





**The DNA of a ‘Searcian’** 




*superpowers we value.* 




  





**The ‘happier’ core** 



* **happier\-at\-heart:** 
**h** 
 umble,
 **a** 
 daptable,
 **p** 
 ositive,
 **p** 
 assionate,
 **i** 
 nnovative,
 **e** 
 xcellence\-minded,
 **r** 
 esponsible.
* **happier\-in\-action:** 
 Not just a poster on the wall; It's how we make decisions, treat each other, show up for clients \& hire or promote people.
* **Thinks like a founder. Acts like an owner.**
* **Always in Beta:** 
 Relentless curiosity. Openness to learn, un\-learn, and re\-learn.
* **Real Optimist:** 
 Views all setbacks as opportunities.
* **Believes in truth over comfort. Ideas over titles. Learning over knowing.**
* **Embraces chaos with calm. Evolves faster than the market.**



  





**The ‘evlos’ mindset** 




 This is the "how" behind your work. It’s a deep\-seated drive to improve, discover, and own.
 


* **Solver\-core:** 
 Problem\-solving is not just a default setting for a Searcian, it is our genuine passion and makes ‘our eyes light up’. We actually solve problems to unwind \& relax.
* **Real improver:** 
 Searcians are built to push for better, not just settle for done. Real solvers Iterate to become better everyday and remain self\-driven.
* **Under\-promise \& over\-deliver.** 
 We love to create pleasant surprises.
* **Authentically original thinking:** 
 Asks the "why" that unlocks what's next. Brings unique, valuable perspectives to every discussion.
* **Built\-to\-last \+ engineered\-to\-scale:** 
 We don't lead with tools. We lead with foundations.
 **Process\-first, AI\-second.**
* **Super\-Learner:** 
 Learns faster, adapts smarter, levels up relentlessly. What you can do tomorrow matters more to us than what you did yesterday. Your learning curve beats experience.



  





**Functional Skills** 



* **P\&L Fluency:** 
 Reads a P\&L and models gainshare economics live — treats a contract as a pricing instrument, not a risk register.
* **Deal\-Room Presence:** 
 Holds the room with Partners, CSP sellers, and clients through a collapsed structure or a hostile round. Energy is a working tool here, not a personality note.
* **Principal's Judgment:** 
 Thinks like an owner of the business, not a service provider to it — knows which risks are worth carrying for margin.
* **Buy vs. Build Judgment:** 
 Knows when jurisdictional depth is worth buying per matter versus building in\-house — a capital\-allocation call, not a staffing default.
* **Function\-Builder Instinct:** 
 Designs a legal function as a system — clause library, playbooks, agents, people — not as a headcount request.



  





**Tech Superpowers** 



* **AI\-Native Legal Practice:** 
 Uses LLMs in your own legal workflow today — drafting, review, research — with an explicit quality\-control method, not just a prompt habit.
* **Agentic Legal Stack Literacy:** 
 Understands drafting agents, review agents, versioned clause libraries, and eval harnesses well enough to specify what the Legal Engineer builds and judge whether it's working.
* **CLM \& CRM Systems Fluency:** 
 Has run contract lifecycle on enterprise CLM tooling (Ironclad, Sirion, Icertis, Agiloft, or equivalent) integrated with a CRM — knows what routing, attribution, and audit trail look like in software.
* **Eval\-Minded:** 
 Treats catch rate and false\-positive rate as the language for whether legal automation is trustworthy. Evaluation, not vibes.



  





**Experience \& Relevance** 



* **12\+ years** 
 , India\-qualified, with personal ownership of US or UK enterprise commercial paper.
* **Outside\-Counsel Command:** 
 Has run outside counsel across three or more jurisdictions.
* **Business\-First Record:** 
 Has structured outcome\-based, gainshare, or at\-risk commercial paper — not just reviewed it. A business background or business\-family exposure is preferred.
* **Location:** 
 Pune, Mumbai, or Ahmedabad.



  





**Bonus Points (you will thrive if you have)** 



* **The "Founder" Bias:** 
 You've built a function, team, or practice from zero — not inherited one already running.
* **Cross\-Domain Judgment:** 
 You've applied your expertise somewhere outside your formal training — a deal, a structure, a risk call outside the textbook.
* **Startup Grit:** 
 You've worn multiple hats in a resource\-constrained environment and solved "0→1" problems.
* **Public Voice:** 
 You've written, spoken, or taught publicly in your domain — not just practiced it privately.

**About The Company**
 A well\-established, promoter\-led Indian pharmaceutical company with a strong portfolio of branded formulations, an extensive domestic presence and growing international operations.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 To lead the organisation’s legal function, providing strategic and commercially pragmatic counsel across corporate, commercial, regulatory, contractual, litigation and compliance matters. The role will partner closely with the MD, Promoters and senior leadership to proactively manage legal risks, strengthen governance and enable business growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the legal function and advise the MD, Promoters and senior leadership.
* Manage corporate, commercial and contractual matters and negotiations.
* Ensure pharma, regulatory, corporate and statutory compliance.
* Oversee litigation, disputes and external legal counsel.
* Protect IP, trademarks and company brands.
* Advise on employment, labour and industrial relations matters.
* Strengthen legal governance, risk management, contracts and MIS.
* Provide commercially pragmatic legal advice to support business growth.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Education: Law degree (LLB); additional qualifications in corporate/commercial law, compliance, or business management advantageous.
* Experience: 18–25 years of overall legal experience with significant exposure in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industries.
* Leadership: Experience operating at Head Legal, General Counsel, Legal Director, VP Legal, or Senior Legal Counsel level; managing external legal firms and multiple legal matters simultaneously; working closely with MDs, Promoters, Boards, and senior leadership.
* Technical Expertise: Corporate and commercial contracts, litigation, regulatory matters, employment law, corporate governance, pharmaceutical regulatory and commercial legal matters, intellectual property, trademark and brand protection.
* Soft Skills: Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, communication skills; hands\-on, commercially oriented; comfortable in an entrepreneurial/promoter\-led environment; ability to build processes and professionalise the legal function while remaining responsive to business needs.


**Educational Qualifications And Experience**
* LLB from a recognised university; additional qualification in Corporate/Commercial Law is preferred.
* 18–25 years of legal experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical/healthcare industry.
* Proven experience across corporate, commercial, regulatory, contracts, litigation and compliance.
* Strong exposure to pharma regulatory, IP/trademark and employment/labour laws.
* Experience advising Promoters, MDs and senior leadership in a business\-facing role.
* Strong negotiation, stakeholder management and commercial acumen, with the ability to operate independently in a promoter\-led environment.


**Key Competencies**
* Commercial Acumen – Balances legal and business priorities.
* Legal Judgement – Strong legal expertise and decision\-making.
* Negotiation Skills – Effective stakeholder and contract management.
* Risk Management – Proactive compliance and risk mitigation.
* Leadership – Hands\-on and execution\-focused, action\-oriented.

title: Associate - Compliance Review Controller
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Compliance Review Controller (Associate)
   

  

**Department** 
 : India Compliance COE
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 CIB
   

  

**India COE Compliance Hub:** 
 The India CoE Compliance Hub serves as a strategic global partner to Compliance functions, helping safeguard the Group’s reputation and manage risk across all business lines. Organized around specialized service domains, the Hub provides expertise in
 **Financial Security (KYC, Sanctions, and Quality Assurance), Operational Risk \& Controls, Conduct, Data Governance, Market Integrity, Operational Efficiency and AI Enablement** 
 , and other
 **transversal Compliance activities** 
 .
   

  

 Working in close partnership with stakeholders across geographies and business lines, the Hub drives operational excellence, enhances risk management capabilities, fosters innovation, and supports the execution of the Group’s global Compliance strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

 The person will be a part of the Transversal Risk Management (TRM) team reporting to Team Lead, Non\-FS Controls.
   

  

* Perform testing and controls as defined by testing and control procedures under the supervision of TRM Managers or their delegates in order to assess and review compliance with legal, regulatory and firm’s policy and procedure requirements
* Maintain an audit trail for all work carried out during the control testing, reporting and action plan stages
* Escalate weaknesses identified to TRM Managers for discussion and further investigation if deemed necessary.
* Draft and validate issues and recommendations addressing the root cause of the issues with stakeholders.
* Ensure that all findings and recommendations are entered into the appropriate tool for tracking purposes, perform periodic follow\-up with stakeholders of open issues and review / validate submitted closure evidence to ensure proper resolution.
* Report results in Digitized Control Sheets, SharePoint Workflow, CIB/TRM SharePoint Reporting tool \& PowerBI dashboards. Ensure to use various tools as rolled out by CIB / TRM\-E team from time to time
* Enhance, deliver, and support the annual TRM Plan, ensuring coverage for existing Firm standards, new regulations, changes to existing regulations, and any audit or exam findings.
* Achieve objectives within strict time constraints.


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* In the spirit of continuous improvement, assist with the identification of potential enhancements to the TRM process, tools, reporting and analytics and provide suggestions on how to improve, add to, or streamline current practices in the firm.
* Assist the team manager with tasks which may include assisting in testing reviews, preparing materials, organizing meetings, and taking minutes.
* Respond timely to internal or external requests for information and analysis.
* Assist in responding to regulatory and internal audit queries.
* Assist with related Compliance monitoring activities as needed.
* Promote a compliance culture within the firm which supposes also to update knowledge on a regular basis.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Excellent IT and excel skills
* Excellent communication and project management skills
* A good understanding of Financial Markets (participants, basic products and activities) and related Compliance topics including AML, Sanctions, KYC, KYI, KYS, KYX, Market Integrity, Market Abuse Surveillance, Swap Dealer, Banking Structural Reforms, Client interest Protection, Client Fiscal Regulations, Professional Ethics topics
* Team player with interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Self\-confidence, ability to stand their ground when required
* Flexibility and adaptability to work on different topics


**Specific Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution
* Compliance, Audit, Risk Management qualifications.


**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
* Minimum 5 years’ experience working for a financial services firm and/or self\-regulatory organization in a Compliance Monitoring/Testing, Internal Audit or regulatory related position.
* Working knowledge of capital markets and investment banking activities and regulatory requirements governing those activities.
* Strong analytical, organizational abilities, project management skills and attention to detail.
* Problem solving, critical thinking, investigative and root cause identification skills.
* Advanced computer skills including MS Excel (including macros), Word, and PowerPoint; Power BI is a plus.
* Excellent execution skills with the ability to work successfully under demanding deadlines.
* Team player with ability to work collaboratively across Compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with front and back\-office staff and senior management
* High ethical standards.
* Flexibility to adapt to a new and changing environment.


**Technical Skills**
* Basic knowledge on AI and python preferred


**Behavioral Skills**
* Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
* Attention to detail / rigor
* Decision Making
* Communication skills \- oral \& written


**Education Level:** 
 Bachelor Degree or equivalent
   

  

**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: Manager, APAC Client Risk
description:
**Proceed with Pride** 
 is Bain’s client selection and acceptance process. Developed in partnership with our Industry and Capability Practice Areas, it helps ensure we can be proud of the work we take on. When concerns arise, Partners are encouraged to engage the Proceed with Pride team for guidance and discussion.
 





 The focus is nearly always on identifying the right mitigating actions to enable us to Proceed with Pride, although in some instances we will jointly decide not to proceed.
 





 Regional Risk Officers (RROs) have been appointed to lead Regional Risk teams to align Proceed with Pride more closely with our line leadership. RROs are experienced, independent Advisory Partners and report to our
 **Chief Risk Officer** 
 , who reports to the Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
 





 In this role, you will support the
 **Senior Manager, APAC Client Risk** 
 , and the
 **APAC RRO** 
 , helping to shape and execute the region’s approach to client selection and acceptance. You’ll be a key driver of strategic thinking and operational execution across risk efforts in the region.
 








  




**Why you’ll want to join**




* **Work at the intersection of ethics, reputation, and real\-world events:** 
 Apply critical thinking to complex topics (e.g., geopolitics, regulatory scrutiny, sensitive sectors, AI), and support senior decision\-making on whether and how Bain engages with clients and different types of work, balancing ethical and reputational trade\-offs with integrity, while protecting Bain’s values and enabling responsible growth.
* **Build a critical capability for Bain’s future:** 
 Proceed with Pride is a growing, evolving function – help shape how we manage emerging risk issues, expand our scope, and modernise how we operate at scale.
* **Direct exposure to senior leadership:** 
 Collaborate with Partners, Office Heads, Practice leaders, Legal, and PR/Comms, and support engagements with EMEA’s Regional Managing Partner (RMP) and Bain’s Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
* **Have fun!** 
 Proceed with Pride is global, yet close\-knit – be part of a collaborative and supportive team with a meaningful mission, a strong culture of camaraderie and plenty of opportunities for professional growth.







  




**Key tasks**






**1\. APAC  Client Selection and Acceptance Process – Lead and manage end\-to\-end risk assessments** 




* Monitor the APAC opportunity pipeline to identify ‘higher risk’ cases flagged by risk guidelines, including work in regulated and reputationally sensitive sectors (e.g., gambling, sensitive areas of healthcare).
* Confirm assessment requirements with Partners and facilitate in\-depth discussions on client context and strategy, reputational considerations, and risk trade\-offs.
* Conduct relevant research, frame key questions, and coordinate input from Legal, PR, and other internal experts.
* Summarise decisions and mitigation plans, monitor implementation, and evaluate outcomes to protect Bain’s reputation and enable responsible growth.







  




**2\. Risk Awareness, Education \& Engagement – Build and sustain a culture of risk mindfulness** 




* Own and produce reporting on client risk and reputational themes across APAC, highlighting strategic implications and emerging external drivers.
* Design and develop briefing materials and coordinate leadership updates for senior stakeholders (including APAC leadership and Practice Area Heads), strengthening Partners’ awareness of their role in client risk and reputation management for Bain.
* Design agendas and run regular sessions with Practice Area Managers (PAMs) to build awareness, surface risks, and strengthen risk capabilities across teams, supporting consistent decision\-making across the region.







  




**3\. Team Enablement \& Innovation – Strengthen the Proceed with Pride team through scalable, forward\-thinking solutions** 




* Support initiatives to build and evolve the team’s purpose and mission, including leveraging AI to automate processes and improve insight generation.
* Continuously refine frameworks and guidelines to remain effective in an ever\-changing, volatile environment, reflecting evolving reputational expectations and strategic priorities.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve team efficiency, collaboration, and impact through innovative tools and approaches, enabling faster, higher\-quality decisions.







  




**About you**






**Experience \& Skills** 




* 3\-6 years of professional experience in consulting, legal, audit, risk, or a similar field.
* Passion for governance and ethics, and for helping Bain decide which work to take on – strategically, reputationally, and responsibly – ensuring we can
 *Proceed with Pride* 
 .
* Strong analytical skills; ability to synthesise complex information and anticipate risks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, especially with senior leaders.
* Strong understanding of current affairs and geopolitical dynamics, and their implications for client strategy and reputational risk.







  




**Education** 




* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.







  




**Personal Attributes** 




* **Collaborative** 
 : Works effectively across teams and functions. Service\-focused.
* **Organised \& Detail\-Oriented** 
 : Keeps processes on track and ensures accuracy.
* **Pragmatic** 
 : Strong problem\-solving ability with a practical sense of what’s achievable.
* **Articulate** 
 : Communicates clearly and with impact – both verbally and in writing.
* **Team player** 
 : Passionate, reliable, and great to work with.
* **Tech\-savvy** 
 : Open to using AI tools and embracing new technologies with a growth mindset.

title: AVP/Business Head - Execution for Asset Reconstruction
company: Intellectual Capital HR Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 AVP – ARC Business – Execution
 



**Department:** 
 ARC Business / Asset Resolution
 



**Reports To:** 
 Senior Management
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience Required:** 
 10–15 Years
 



**Educational Qualification:** 
 MBA in Finance / CA / CFA / CS / LLB or equivalent postgraduate qualification
 



 ABOUT THE ORGANISATION
 



 A leading
 **RBI\-registered Asset Reconstruction Company (ARC)** 
 engaged in the acquisition and resolution of stressed assets from banks and financial institutions.
 



 The organisation focuses on structured and efficient resolution strategies, including restructuring, enforcement and asset monetisation, with an emphasis on value maximisation and timely recovery.
 



 ROLE OVERVIEW
 



 The
 **AVP – ARC Business – Execution** 
 will be responsible for managing the
 **end\-to\-end execution of stressed\-asset transactions and resolution initiatives** 
 .
 



 The role will involve transaction evaluation, financial analysis, due diligence, structuring, bidding, documentation, transaction closure, asset onboarding and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
 



 This is a
 **purely execution\-oriented role** 
 and does
 **not** 
 involve Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Origination or Asset Acquisition.
 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



**1\. Transaction Evaluation \& Execution** 



* Evaluate stressed\-asset opportunities referred for execution.
* Analyse borrower exposures, outstanding debt, security, recovery prospects and available information.
* Coordinate financial, legal, technical and commercial due diligence.
* Review valuations, cash flows, security cover and potential resolution scenarios.
* Prepare transaction evaluation notes and management presentations.



**2\. Deal Structuring \& Bidding** 



* Support structuring of stressed\-asset transactions within applicable regulatory and internal frameworks.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of bids under Swiss Challenge, bilateral and competitive processes.
* Review transaction structures, pricing assumptions and financial models.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of bidding processes.



**3\. Transaction Closure \& Asset Onboarding** 



* Drive post\-bid execution and transaction closure activities.
* Coordinate documentation, conditions precedent and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Legal, Risk, Finance, Compliance and Resolution teams.
* Ensure smooth onboarding and transfer of assets following transaction closure.
* Track and resolve outstanding transaction\-related matters.



**4\. Resolution Execution Support** 



* Work closely with the Asset Resolution team in implementing approved resolution strategies.
* Support restructuring, enforcement, settlement and asset monetisation initiatives.
* Monitor resolution milestones, recovery actions and execution timelines.
* Provide periodic transaction and resolution updates to senior management.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management** 



* Coordinate with internal teams and external legal, valuation, diligence and advisory professionals.
* Ensure timely exchange and validation of transaction information.
* Identify execution issues and coordinate their resolution.
* Escalate material transaction risks, delays and dependencies to senior management.



**6\. MIS, Governance \& Compliance** 



* Maintain transaction\-level MIS and execution trackers.
* Monitor transaction timelines, documentation and closure milestones.
* Ensure adherence to applicable RBI guidelines, regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Maintain appropriate transaction documentation and records.
* Identify opportunities to improve transaction execution processes.



 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
 


* Timely execution and closure of transactions.
* Transaction evaluation quality and accuracy.
* Due diligence and documentation turnaround.
* Bidding\-process efficiency.
* Successful asset onboarding following transaction closure.
* Timely implementation of approved resolution strategies.
* Regulatory and process compliance.
* Effective cross\-functional stakeholder coordination.



 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS
 


* 10–15 years of relevant experience in
 **ARC, Banking, NBFC, Special Situations, Stressed Assets, Corporate Credit, Debt Resolution or Private Debt** 
 .
* Demonstrated experience in
 **transaction execution, stressed\-asset resolution or distressed\-debt processes** 
 .
* Experience in due diligence, transaction structuring, bidding, documentation and closure.
* MBA Finance / CA / CFA / CS / LLB or equivalent qualification preferred.



 REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES
 


* Strong understanding of
 **SARFAESI, IBC 2016, RBI regulations relating to transfer of loan exposures and debt restructuring mechanisms** 
 .
* Strong financial analysis and modelling skills.
* Experience in stressed\-asset transaction execution and resolution.
* Strong understanding of bidding and transaction\-closure processes.
* Excellent project and transaction management skills.
* Strong documentation and analytical capabilities.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Legal, Risk, Finance, Compliance and Resolution teams.
* Strong communication and management\-presentation skills.



 ROLE EXCLUSIONS
 



 This position is
 **strictly execution\-focused** 
 and does
 **not** 
 carry responsibility for:
 


* Business Development / Sales
* Marketing / Brand Building
* Asset Origination
* Asset Sourcing / Acquisition
* Lead Generation
* Investor Acquisition
* Capital Raising
* Relationship\-led Business Generation



**Primary focus: Transaction Evaluation → Due Diligence → Structuring → Bidding → Closure → Asset Onboarding → Resolution Execution.**

title: Associate Director – Quality, Compendial Compliance & Analytical Changes
description:
**Job Description**
 Our Quality Assurance group ensures every single material inside our products is manufactured, processed, tested, packaged, stored and distributed aligned with our incredibly high standards of quality and meets all regulatory requirements. Partnering across our internal manufacturing facilities, external contract manufacturers and suppliers we create an interdependent global manufacturing network dedicated to deliver a compliant, reliable supply to customers and patients on time, every time, across the globe.
   

  

**Essential Function(s) Includes, But Is Not Limited To**
* Manages organizational/functional support for activities such as Analytical Standards and analytical change control, new products, in\-line products, packaging, outsourcing, divestitures, compendial compliance, etc.
* Provides quality oversight for our Manufacturing Division manufacturing sites and laboratories, Regulatory, Divisional Stability, External Quality, Procurement, our Research \& Development Division, Technical Operations, etc.
* Performs the appropriate document review, change control and support activities associated with their position and ensures work is in compliance with all regulatory expectations.
* Supervises junior staff members and manages appropriate group functions/activities including prioritization of work, resource allocation and issue resolution.
* The incumbent is responsible for assuring the application of and conformance to, current Good Manufacturing Practices.
* The incumbent is also responsible for providing input for compliance and organizational objectives as well as for recruiting and mentoring highly technical scientific personnel.


**Primary Activities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Supervises and ensures the coordination and maintenance of product, active ingredient, intermediate, raw material, and component Analytical Standards. This may include, but is not limited to addition/deletion/modification to analytical methods, specifications, product numbers, and product descriptions. Ensures that all Quality Standards are maintained in accordance with established divisional and departmental procedures and issued in a timely fashion.
* Ensures and provides Analytical Standard support and coordination for new product introductions and registrations including AS representation in new product teams (Quality, Analytical, and/or Regulatory Sub\-teams). Ensures all activities associated with documents are performed in an accurate and timely manner including appropriate reviews, approvals, and issuance of documents.
* Supervises the coordination, evaluation, disposition and implementation of all Analytical Standard changes/modifications in accordance with the Change Request \- Analytical (ACR) process. Evaluates and investigates ACRs to determine impact, appropriateness, and prioritization.
* Ensures the review, approval and issuance of Analytical Standards are performed in a timely manner and in compliance with departmental practices and GMP regulations.
* Supervises and aids in the establishment and implementation of guidance, procedures and direction for all departmental activities.

description:

title: Executive - Payroll & Compliances
description:
**About Us**
 At Ugaoo, we’ve always believed plants are more than décor, they’re companions, healers, and reminders of what truly matters. What began as a small idea sparked by a plant on a windowsill has grown into India’s leading gardening brand, backed by marquee investors like DSG Consumer Partners and V3 Ventures. From our 25\-acre farm in Talegaon to a thriving D2C store and retail presence across Pune, Mumbai, Delhi and
   

  

 Bangaluru, we’re building an ecosystem that brings nature closer to homes, offices, and communities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and process\-driven Executive \- Payroll \& Compliances to manage day\-to\-day payroll activities and support statutory compliance while ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to all applicable regulations. This role will be responsible for managing payroll inputs, processing monthly payroll, supporting statutory filings, maintaining employee records, coordinating with Finance and HR Operations, and ensuring timely closure of payroll and compliance activities. The ideal candidate brings a good understanding of Indian payroll, taxation, statutory requirements, and HRMS systems, along with strong attention to detail and the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Payroll Management
   

  

* Manage and validate monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, salary revisions, deductions, reimbursements, and variable pay.
* Process monthly payroll through HRMS, preferably Keka, ensuring accuracy and timely closure.
* Support payroll processing for a large and diverse workforce across blue\-collar and white\-collar categories.
* Prepare and validate salary structures, deductions, reimbursements, and variable pay inputs.
* Process full \& final settlements for exiting employees and ensure timely closure of payroll\-related documentation.
* Coordinate with HR Operations to ensure accurate employee lifecycle data including onboarding, confirmations, attendance, leave records, exits, and documentation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payroll inputs, deductions, reconciliations, salary disbursement, and payroll\-related queries.
* Perform payroll checks and reconciliations to identify and resolve discrepancies before payroll closure.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee payroll records in the HRMS.
* Support the preparation of HR letters, payroll reports, and other payroll\-related documentation.


 Compliance \& Statutory Requirements
   

  

* Prepare and maintain data required for monthly and periodic statutory compliances including PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, and TDS.
* Support timely statutory filings and ensure required employee and payroll data is accurate and complete.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee records, compliance trackers, licenses, and related documentation.
* Track statutory deadlines and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of compliance activities.
* Coordinate with external consultants for statutory filings, reconciliations, and compliance requirements.
* Support audits, inspections, and queries from consultants, auditors, and regulatory authorities.
* Support compliance activities related to Trade Licenses, Shops \& Establishments requirements, Fire NOCs, and other applicable registrations.
* Stay updated on relevant payroll and statutory changes and highlight any required actions to the Manager.


 Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

* Prepare monthly payroll MIS reports and compliance trackers for management review.
* Prepare headcount, payroll cost, deductions, and statutory liability reports.
* Reconcile payroll data with Finance records and identify discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate payroll and compliance dashboards and reports.
* Provide payroll data and documentation required for audits and internal reviews.
* Identify recurring payroll issues and support improvements in payroll processes and controls.


**What You'll Bring**
* 2 to 5 years of experience in payroll, HR operations, and statutory compliance.
* Experience in managing day\-to\-day payroll activities for a large employee population, preferably across blue\-collar and white\-collar workforce.
* Good understanding of Indian payroll practices, income tax, PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Experience working with HRMS or payroll systems, preferably Keka.
* Good knowledge of Excel and experience working with payroll reports and reconciliations.
* Understanding of salary structures, payroll inputs, full \& final settlements, statutory filings, and compliance documentation.
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and time management.
* Good coordination and communication skills with the ability to work closely with HR and Finance teams.
* Strong sense of ownership, confidentiality, and process discipline.
* A team player with a positive attitude and the ability to thrive in a dynamic startup environment.

 Global Indirect Procurement
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Job Summary:
   

  

 As Indirect Procurement Sourcing Manager, you will lead commercial procurement activities across multiple spend categories. You will help shape bid strategies, run competitive tendering, perform bid leveling, and negotiate contracts and change orders to deliver best\-value outcomes (cost, schedule, quality, safety, and risk).
   

  

 This position is intended for an experienced procurement professional who can quickly integrate with project teams, manage multiple workstreams in parallel, and drive clear commercial outcomes with suppliers. Success requires strong understanding of commercial construction bidding, capital equipment, professional services, and other related categories.
   

  

 The Sourcing Manager will drive procurement support for various projects across multiple spend categories, as assigned.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 What You’ll Do
   

  

**The Sourcing Manager Will**
* Develop sourcing and tendering strategies for various projects and scopes aligned to project schedule and design maturity.
* Run end\-to\-end competitive bids: develop RFIs/RFPs/RFQs, manage bidder communications, chair bid walks, and ensure clear scope definition and commercial terms.
* Perform bid analysis and leveling (scope, inclusions/exclusions, assumptions, schedule impacts), partnering with design/construction leads or other stakeholders to validate technical alignment.
* Lead commercial negotiations and contracting: pricing structure, payment terms, retention, liquidated damages, insurance, warranties, bonds, and key risk clauses in coordination with Legal.
* Support cost estimating/cost modeling, should\-cost reviews, and value engineering discussions to improve total installed cost while maintaining required standards.
* Drive contract administration support: change order evaluation, claims avoidance, progress payment reviews, and commercial issue resolution.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Construction/Facilities, Engineering/Design, EHS, Finance, and Legal to ensure procurement decisions support safety, quality, schedule, and compliance requirements.
* Track procurement milestones and savings/value metrics (award schedule, cost vs. estimate, change order trends) and provide concise status reporting to project leadership.
* Assess supplier/contractor commercial risk (financial stability, capacity, contract exposure) and recommend mitigation actions.
* Maintain a qualified bidder list and support market intelligence on regional construction conditions, labor/material pricing, and contracting practices.


**Who We’re Looking For**
* Qualifications:
+ Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or related field (or equivalent experience).

title: People Operations Partner
description:
**Job Summary And Purpose**
 The People Operations Partner provides in\-country\-specific HR operational expertise within the global HR operating model. Acting as the Tier 2 operational HR lead for their assigned country, the role manages complex employee lifecycle activity, local legislative requirements, employee relations support, and operational implementation of HR processes and business change.
   

  

 The role serves as the primary operational HR expert for managers, HRBPs, Payroll, Legal and COEs on country\-specific employment practices, compliance requirements, and operational people matters. The position ensures global HR processes are delivered effectively while remaining compliant with local legislation and market practice.
   

  

 This role is distinct from Global People Services and focuses on judgement\-based operational HR support, local expertise, compliance, and operational execution rather than high\-volume transactional query handling.
   

  

**Main Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Country HR Operations \- Act as the operational HR lead for assigned country populations.
* Manage complex employee lifecycle activity including contractual changes, leave management, transfers, and local compliance processes.
* Ensure operational HR processes are delivered in line with local employment legislation and company standards.
* Support implementation of global HR initiatives within country\-specific legislative and operational frameworks.
* Coordinate with Payroll, Benefits, HRIS, Finance and external vendors to suport compliant local delivery.
* Employee Relations \& Compliance
* Support employee relations matters including disciplinary, grievance, absence, performance, and workplace concerns in partnership with managers and HRBPs.
* Provide practical guidance on local employment legislation, policies, and operational risk.
* Escalate complex or high\-risk matters appropriately to Regional Ops Lead or Legal team.
* Maintain compliance with local labour law, working time obligations, statutory requirements, and internal governance standards.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory documentation requirements.
* Business \& Manager Support
* Provide operational HR guidance to managers on employee lifecycle and country\-specific people matters.
* Support operational delivery of organisational changes, restructures, transfers, and workforce actions.
* Partner with HRBPs to operationalise business decisions and workforce changes.
* Ensure managers are supported through operational implementation of HR processes and policy application.
* Operational Governance \& Improvement
* Identify operational risks, processes, gaps, and opportunities for improvement or standardisation.
* Contribute to development and maintenance of operational process documentation and country guidance.
* Support implementation of new HR systems, operational processes, and service delivery requirements.


**Minimum Education \& Experience**
* Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related field preferred
* Professional HR qualification (e.g. CIPD, SHRM, HRCI or equivalent) desirable.
* 6\+ years of experience in relevant country\-specific HR operational experience required.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong HR generalist experience with operational HR ownership
* Experience supporting employee relations and operational HR delivery within a multinational environment.
* Strong understanding of local employment legislation and HR operational practices.
* Ability to manage complex operational issues requiring judgement and practical application.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently within a global operating model.
* Strong organisational, prioritisation, and problem\-solving capability.
* Experience working with HR systems and operational workflows.

 The All India Football Federation (AIFF) invites applications for the position of Legal Associate on a contractual basis at its Headquarters, Football House, New Delhi.
   

  

 The Legal, Regulatory and Governance Department is responsible for advising and supporting the Federation on a wide range of disciplinary, governance, regulatory, commercial, contractual, litigation and other legal matters arising from the administration and development of football in India.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work closely with the Legal Department and will gain exposure to the legal and regulatory framework governing a national sporting federation, including matters involving AIFF regulations, FIFA and AFC regulations, contractual arrangements, disciplinary proceedings, governance, litigation and sports\-related commercial matters.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Legal Assistant will be expected to assist the Legal, Regulatory and Governance Department in the following areas:
   

  

* Legal Drafting \& Documentation
* Assist in the drafting, reviewing, formatting and finalisation of legal documents, correspondence, notices, agreements and other legal instruments.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing service agreements, sponsorship and partnership agreements, licensing arrangements, commercial contracts, consultancy agreements, tenders, addenda, corrigenda and other contractual documentation.
* Prepare legal briefs, notes, summaries, chronologies and other documentation required by the Legal Department.
* Regulatory \& Governance Matters
* Assist in the drafting, review and revision of AIFF regulations, policies, circulars, guidelines and other governance documents.
* Conduct legal and regulatory research on matters concerning the AIFF Constitution, FIFA and AFC regulations, applicable Indian laws and sports\-governance frameworks.
* Assist in reviewing Federation policies and procedures to identify potential legal, regulatory and compliance risks and ensure that the Federation’s interests are adequately protected.
* Disciplinary \& Sports Regulatory Matters
* Assist in matters relating to disciplinary proceedings, appeals, player status, registration, transfers and other regulatory disputes.
* Assist in the work of AIFF committees and bodies dealing with disciplinary, ethics, appeal and other regulatory matters, as required.
* Litigation, Arbitration \& External Counsel Coordination
* Assist the Legal Department in coordinating with external advocates, law firms and legal counsel engaged by the Federation.
* Assist in compiling documents, factual briefs, legal records and instructions required by external legal counsel in connection with court proceedings, arbitration, sports disputes and proceedings before the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS).
* Track ongoing legal matters, hearings, deadlines, filings and instructions and assist in ensuring timely coordination between the Federation and its external counsel.
* Assist in legal research and preparation of materials for litigation and other dispute\-resolution proceedings.
* Commercial \& Contractual Matters
* Assist in reviewing commercial arrangements undertaken by the Federation, including sponsorship, partnership, licensing, branding, media, service\-provider and other commercial agreements.
* Assist in identifying contractual, compliance and legal risks and ensure that the Federation’s interests are appropriately safeguarded.
* Assist in reviewing tenders, RFPs, bid documents, contractual terms and related communications from a legal and compliance perspective.
* Legal Research \& Advisory Support
* Conduct research on Indian sports law, commercial law, employment law, intellectual property, competition law, data protection, consumer protection and other areas relevant to the Federation’s operations.
* Research and analyse FIFA, AFC and other international sporting regulations and their application to matters before the Federation.
* Prepare legal research notes and assist senior members of the Department in developing legal positions and recommendations.
* Departmental \& Federation Support
* Assist the Legal Department in responding to legal queries received from various departments, Member Associations, clubs, players, officials, service providers and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal departments to obtain relevant information and documentation for legal matters.
* Assist in monitoring compliance with contractual, regulatory and statutory obligations.
* Undertake such other legal, regulatory, governance and administrative responsibilities as may be assigned by the Department from time to time.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Educational Qualification**
* LL.B. / B.A. LL.B. / B.B.A. LL.B. or an equivalent recognised law degree.


**Professional Experience**
* Candidates with 0–2 years of Post\-Qualification Experience (PQE) are particularly encouraged to apply.
* Fresh law graduates with relevant internships and a demonstrated interest in sports law, football governance, commercial law or regulatory matters will also be considered.
* Prior internship or work experience in sports law, commercial law, litigation, regulatory law or corporate law will be an advantage.
* Candidates with experience in or familiarity with FIFA and AFC regulations, sports governance, disciplinary regulations, player regulations or CAS proceedings will be preferred.


**Core Skills**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

**About The Team**
 Tegus by AlphaSense facilitates extremely valuable calls between our clients and experts. Given the proprietary insights in these conversations, compliance is critical to our business, and a key component of our value add. The Compliance Team provides our clients with actionable insights while maintaining the highest legal and regulatory standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role will be part of our growing India Compliance Review team, providing critical coverage across global time zones to help ensure 24x5 compliance review support for our U.S. and international operations. As a Compliance Analyst, you will play a crucial role in supporting our content generation while protecting our clients from potentially sensitive information. You will gain extensive knowledge of Tegus’ cutting edge compliance program to facilitate the review of expert call transcripts. This role is fast\-paced, so agility and ability to work under a tight deadline are key.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Review expert call transcripts to detect and resolve any instances of material nonpublic and confidential information in accordance with internal protocols, applicable laws/regulations, and industry standards.
* Complete due diligence review of each call, document any violations comprehensively, and escalate non\-compliance with Tegus sourcing guidelines as necessary.
* Conduct advanced research of financial reports and regulatory filings using internal databases and external resources to determine the extent to which information exists in the public domain.
* Proactively manage internal and external communications while maintaining efficiency and adaptability in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environment.
* Perform administrative tasks, including but not limited to, inputting, tracking, and maintaining accurate data on processes, transcripts, and workflows, while identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency.


**Who You Are**
* 1\-2 years of experience in research, compliance, legal support or operations roles — such as paralegal, legal assistant, analyst, or BPO/editorial specialist or similar — is preferred, but not required.
* Acute attention to detail and strong written and verbal fluency in English and reading comprehension with proofreading, drafting, and investigative/research experience.
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks, manage time, and remain highly organized while working independently.
* Thrives in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and contribute to innovative solutions that support Tegus’ business needs.


 AlphaSense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non\-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
   

  

 In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
   

  

 Recruiting Scams and Fraud
   

  

 We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note

 Insurance, Dispute \& resolution, teamwork, stakeholder management

 Ramboll is a leading engineering, architecture and consultancy company.  M3M India is looking for a Legal Associate to join its in\-house legal team in Gurugram. This is a generalist role built for someone early in their career who wants breadth rather than a single narrow lane. You will rotate across real estate and land matters, contracts and commercial documentation, litigation and dispute support, and corporate and regulatory compliance — and be developed in whichever of these you show the strongest aptitude for..
 



 We are also actively building an AI\-enabled legal function. Candidates who already use AI tools fluently for research, summarization and first\-pass drafting — and who understand where those tools must not be trusted — will be given clear preference.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Conduct legal research on property, contract, corporate and regulatory questions and convert findings into crisp, decision\-ready notes for the business.
