* Draft, vet and mark up commercial agreements — vendor, consultant, contractor, channel partner, brokerage, lease, MoUs and NDAs.
* Support RERA and other regulatory compliance: filings, registrations, disclosure obligations and compliance trackers.
* Support litigation and dispute management — case tracking, document collation, briefing and coordinating with external counsel, and drafting replies to notices, including consumer and RERA matters.
* Maintain the contract repository, obligation trackers and legal MIS, and flag renewals, expiries and risk items proactively.
* Use AI research and drafting tools to compress turnaround time, with every output independently verified against primary sources before it leaves your desk.



  





**What we are looking for** 




**Essential** 



* LL.B. / B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) from a recognised law school;
 **graduates of National Law Universities are strongly preferred** 
 .
* 1–2 years of post\-qualification experience in a law firm, in\-house legal team, or chambers. Strong candidates with relevant internships plus one year of experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools for legal research and drafting — for example Claude, ChatGPT, Harvey, Lexis\+ AI, SCC Online AI or comparable platforms — with sound judgment on verification and confidentiality.
* Clear, precise legal drafting and the ability to write for business readers, not only for lawyers.
* Willing and able to join within 10 days.



**Preferred** 



* Exposure to real estate, infrastructure, construction or land transactions.
* Familiarity with RERA, the Haryana land and revenue framework, and related approvals.
* Comfort with contract lifecycle management or legal\-tech tooling.
* Moot court, journal, or legal\-aid credentials from law school.

title: Assistant Director-Manager-Data Privacy-Incident Response
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Description**
**Group** 
 : GDS GCO Enablement Team
   

  

**The opportunity**
 This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst playing an instrumental role in advising on data privacy related matters. We are looking for an experienced lawyer with expertise in the data privacy domain to join EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) team supporting the General Counsel’s Office (GCO).
   

  

 The successful candidate will work closely with the Global Lead Counsel – Data Incident Response (a Director in Global Data Protection responsible for the Global Incident Response program) to support the maintenance, coordination and continuous improvement of the Global Incident Response (IR) Program in collaboration with key stakeholders and data protection teams around the world.
   

  

 The role will also play a key part in supporting the management of multijurisdictional incident responses.
   

  

 You will work closely with business and Information Security stakeholders and Data Protection leadership and team members.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Provide legal oversight and guidance on the management of global data protection and privacy incidents ensuring compliance with EY policies, applicable laws, and regulatory requirements.
* Support the Global Deputy Lead Counsel – Data Protection Incident Response and the Chief Privacy Officer in the management of complex and strategically significant data incidents.
* Coordinate with Information Security, Risk Management, General Counsel teams, and other key stakeholders to ensure data incidents are managed consistently and effectively across jurisdictions.
* Develop and maintain oversight of data incident tracking, reporting, metrics, and trend analysis to support risk management and executive reporting across the EY organisation.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of EY’s global data incident response framework, policies, procedures, and governance processes.

* Contribute to the development and delivery of training, awareness initiatives, and guidance materials to strengthen understanding of data protection obligations and data incident response requirements across EY.
* Oversee onboarding, capability building, and career development initiatives within the team.
* Allocate work, manage utilization, and ensure delivery aligned with SLAs, quality measures, and stakeholder expectations.
* Provide coaching, performance feedback, and development support to team members.
* Stakeholder management and assistance in business development initiatives.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross\-border data incidents and advising senior stakeholders on legal, regulatory, and risk considerations.
* Strong knowledge of EU and international data protection laws, particularly the GDPR, with familiarity with privacy legislation in other key jurisdictions considered advantageous.
* Experience interpreting and applying legal requirements relating to personal data breaches, regulatory investigations, law enforcement requests, and crisis management scenarios.
* Excellent legal judgement, analytical skills, and the ability to provide practical, risk\-based advice in high\-pressure situations.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working in a complex global organisation and managing matters across multiple jurisdictions and cultures.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Have a good understanding of emerging technologies such as cloud computing, RPA, AI etc.
* Experiences in client handling and leading a team of legal professionals.
* Ability to team effectively with onshore legal team and colleagues in other functions.
* Highly responsive with ability to manage high workload volumes efficiently and effectively
* Solution oriented with focus on exceptional client service.
* Confidence, maturity and high degree of awareness to be able to work effectively with a broad base of senior\-level internal stakeholders.
* Sensitivity to intercultural contacts and communication.
* Strong sense of personal responsibility and ownership for success of a given task.
* Eagerness to contribute to a team\-oriented environment and ability to work cooperatively with other teams and country practices, demonstrating cultural sensitivity;
* Ability to adapt, cross\-skill, up\-skill and work towards continuous improvements to improve efficiencies and processes within the team.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
**Qualifications**
* Must be a qualified lawyer with consistent strong academic record.
* Mandatory a CIPP (E) certified. Other recognised privacy certifications (e.g., CIPM, CIPT) will be considered an advantage.


**Experience**
* Minimum 8 years of years of relevant post\-qualification experience (preferably in a multi\-national corporate).


**Other Personal Characteristics**
* Unquestioned ethics and integrity.
* High level of self\-confidence and energy.
* High level of intellectual agility, self\-motivation, resourcefulness, and patience.
* Attention to detail.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across ten countries – Argentina, India, China, Philippines, Poland, Mexico, Spain, UK, Hungary, Sri Lanka – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Global Supplier Risk & Governance Director
description:
**Locations** 
 : Lisbon \| Gurgaon
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Enterprise Services (ES) was established in 2022 to provide efficient, resilient, and scalable services to support the evolving needs and complexities of a more digital BCG. ES brings together business\-critical operations \- such as Procurement \& Payables, Global Finance Operations, and Executive Support Services \- alongside specialist expertise including Real Estate, Travel, and Meetings \& Events. United by a common service mindset, ES enables every BCGer to focus on the work that matters most by giving time and energy back through streamlined, reliable service delivery. In doing so, ES creates cost advantage and strengthens BCG’s market differentiation, while reducing risk through consistent controls and business continuity. Through scalable platforms and globally integrated ways of working across our strategic core global hubs, Enterprise Services enhances agility and helps unlock the potential of those who advance the world.
   

  

 Enterprise Procurement \& Payables (EP\&P) helps maximize value from BCG's supplier relationships while ensuring strong governance, responsible risk management, and operational resilience across the supplier lifecycle.
   

  

 As Global Supplier Risk \& Governance Director, you will lead the evolution of BCG's supplier governance capability, establishing the frameworks, operating models, and strategic programs that ensure our global supplier base remains resilient, compliant, and aligned with BCG's business priorities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Reporting to the Senior Director responsible for Strategic Supplier Management, you will shape the future direction of supplier governance across Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), ESG, supplier performance, policy, client assurance, and supplier lifecycle management. Working across Procurement, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Technology, and Enterprise Services, you will translate complex regulatory and operational requirements into scalable governance capabilities that protect BCG while enabling the business. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

**Strategic Supplier Management \& Governance**
* Define and evolve BCG's Strategic Supplier Management framework, ensuring effective governance across the supplier lifecycle.
* Lead future\-state initiatives spanning TPRM, ESG, supplier performance, supplier policy, client assurance, and supplier governance.
* Design scalable operating models that balance commercial value, operational efficiency, and enterprise risk.
* Establish governance forums, decision\-making processes, and accountability structures that strengthen supplier management across the firm.


**Risk, Policy \& Regulatory Leadership**
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Enterprise Risk, Information Security, Privacy, and other control functions to ensure supplier governance remains aligned with evolving regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
* Sponsor the development of policies, standards, guidance, and control frameworks supporting supplier governance.
* Provide strategic leadership during supplier incidents, regulatory changes, and client assurance activities.
* Ensure supplier governance capabilities continue to evolve alongside BCG's broader risk management strategy.


**Transformation, Technology \& AI**
* Lead strategic transformation initiatives that modernize supplier governance through technology, automation, and AI.
* Identify opportunities to simplify supplier management processes while improving user experience and governance effectiveness.
* Partner with Product, Technology, Data, and AI teams to embed digital capabilities across supplier management.
* Use analytics and operational insights to continuously improve governance effectiveness and supplier performance.


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to Procurement leadership and senior stakeholders across Enterprise Services.
* Build strong partnerships across regions and functions, influencing without formal authority to drive alignment and adoption.
* Lead complex cross\-functional initiatives involving Procurement, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Technology.
* Develop organizational capability by coaching colleagues, sharing expertise, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.


**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
* Designing enterprise governance frameworks that balance business enablement, compliance, and operational resilience.
* Translating strategic priorities into scalable supplier governance capabilities.
* Leading complex transformation initiatives across highly matrixed global organizations.
* Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influencing enterprise decisions.
* Applying structured problem solving to complex governance, regulatory, and operational challenges.
* Using technology, data, and AI to improve governance effectiveness and user experience.
* Communicating complex risk and governance topics clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Leading through influence while building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience leading supplier governance, procurement, third\-party risk, compliance, enterprise risk, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated success designing and implementing enterprise governance frameworks.
* Deep understanding of supplier lifecycle management, TPRM, supplier governance, ESG, or related disciplines.
* Experience leading large cross\-functional transformation initiatives in global organizations.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across regions and functions.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience leveraging technology, automation, and AI to modernize governance capabilities.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will work closely with Procurement leadership, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, Enterprise Risk, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Data Privacy, Finance, Product, and Technology teams. You will also partner extensively with regional stakeholders and senior leaders across BCG to ensure supplier governance continues to evolve in support of the firm's strategic priorities.
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Manager, APAC Client Risk
description:
**Proceed with Pride** 
 is Bain’s client selection and acceptance process. Developed in partnership with our Industry and Capability Practice Areas, it helps ensure we can be proud of the work we take on. When concerns arise, Partners are encouraged to engage the Proceed with Pride team for guidance and discussion.
 





 The focus is nearly always on identifying the right mitigating actions to enable us to Proceed with Pride, although in some instances we will jointly decide not to proceed.
 





 Regional Risk Officers (RROs) have been appointed to lead Regional Risk teams to align Proceed with Pride more closely with our line leadership. RROs are experienced, independent Advisory Partners and report to our
 **Chief Risk Officer** 
 , who reports to the Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
 





 In this role, you will support the
 **Senior Manager, APAC Client Risk** 
 , and the
 **APAC RRO** 
 , helping to shape and execute the region’s approach to client selection and acceptance. You’ll be a key driver of strategic thinking and operational execution across risk efforts in the region.
 








  




**Why you’ll want to join**




* **Work at the intersection of ethics, reputation, and real\-world events:** 
 Apply critical thinking to complex topics (e.g., geopolitics, regulatory scrutiny, sensitive sectors, AI), and support senior decision\-making on whether and how Bain engages with clients and different types of work, balancing ethical and reputational trade\-offs with integrity, while protecting Bain’s values and enabling responsible growth.
* **Build a critical capability for Bain’s future:** 
 Proceed with Pride is a growing, evolving function – help shape how we manage emerging risk issues, expand our scope, and modernise how we operate at scale.
* **Direct exposure to senior leadership:** 
 Collaborate with Partners, Office Heads, Practice leaders, Legal, and PR/Comms, and support engagements with EMEA’s Regional Managing Partner (RMP) and Bain’s Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
* **Have fun!** 
 Proceed with Pride is global, yet close\-knit – be part of a collaborative and supportive team with a meaningful mission, a strong culture of camaraderie and plenty of opportunities for professional growth.







  




**Key tasks**






**1\. APAC  Client Selection and Acceptance Process – Lead and manage end\-to\-end risk assessments** 




* Monitor the APAC opportunity pipeline to identify ‘higher risk’ cases flagged by risk guidelines, including work in regulated and reputationally sensitive sectors (e.g., gambling, sensitive areas of healthcare).
* Confirm assessment requirements with Partners and facilitate in\-depth discussions on client context and strategy, reputational considerations, and risk trade\-offs.
* Conduct relevant research, frame key questions, and coordinate input from Legal, PR, and other internal experts.
* Summarise decisions and mitigation plans, monitor implementation, and evaluate outcomes to protect Bain’s reputation and enable responsible growth.







  




**2\. Risk Awareness, Education \& Engagement – Build and sustain a culture of risk mindfulness** 




* Own and produce reporting on client risk and reputational themes across APAC, highlighting strategic implications and emerging external drivers.
* Design and develop briefing materials and coordinate leadership updates for senior stakeholders (including APAC leadership and Practice Area Heads), strengthening Partners’ awareness of their role in client risk and reputation management for Bain.
* Design agendas and run regular sessions with Practice Area Managers (PAMs) to build awareness, surface risks, and strengthen risk capabilities across teams, supporting consistent decision\-making across the region.







  




**3\. Team Enablement \& Innovation – Strengthen the Proceed with Pride team through scalable, forward\-thinking solutions** 




* Support initiatives to build and evolve the team’s purpose and mission, including leveraging AI to automate processes and improve insight generation.
* Continuously refine frameworks and guidelines to remain effective in an ever\-changing, volatile environment, reflecting evolving reputational expectations and strategic priorities.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve team efficiency, collaboration, and impact through innovative tools and approaches, enabling faster, higher\-quality decisions.







  




**About you**






**Experience \& Skills** 




* 3\-6 years of professional experience in consulting, legal, audit, risk, or a similar field.
* Passion for governance and ethics, and for helping Bain decide which work to take on – strategically, reputationally, and responsibly – ensuring we can
 *Proceed with Pride* 
 .
* Strong analytical skills; ability to synthesise complex information and anticipate risks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, especially with senior leaders.
* Strong understanding of current affairs and geopolitical dynamics, and their implications for client strategy and reputational risk.







  




**Education** 




* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.







  




**Personal Attributes** 




* **Collaborative** 
 : Works effectively across teams and functions. Service\-focused.
* **Organised \& Detail\-Oriented** 
 : Keeps processes on track and ensures accuracy.
* **Pragmatic** 
 : Strong problem\-solving ability with a practical sense of what’s achievable.
* **Articulate** 
 : Communicates clearly and with impact – both verbally and in writing.
* **Team player** 
 : Passionate, reliable, and great to work with.
* **Tech\-savvy** 
 : Open to using AI tools and embracing new technologies with a growth mindset.

title: Conflict and Intake Analyst

 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4\-6 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm built around entrepreneurial, action\-oriented professionals who solve complex client problems and deliver measurable results. The firm values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, creating a collaborative environment for independent thinkers and doers. The center supports end\-to\-end client delivery and thought leadership rather than traditional back\-office work. Its teams serve the Americas, EMEA, and APAC across industries including Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The rapidly growing GCC is already a 1,000\+ member team. It combines consulting and industry expertise with specialized talent, automation, and hybrid delivery models to improve speed, scale, quality, and client value.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Conflicts \& Intake Analyst owns the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of legal conflict checks and business\-intake records for new clients, matters, and existing engagements. The role uses conflicts databases, Boolean search techniques, structured review, and stakeholder follow\-up to identify related parties, clarify discrepancies, and support ethical risk decisions. Reporting to the Team Manager, you will work with attorneys and business representatives to vet incoming requests, update matter records, and prepare clear reports for review and approval. Your work will protect the firm from conflicts of interest, improve intake quality, and enable teams to pursue new business with confidence. This onsite Gurgaon role requires sound judgment, strong organization, and flexibility for scheduled after\-hours, weekend, and rotational on\-call coverage when business demands require it.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Run timely and accurate conflict searches for preliminary checks, formally submitted new business, new clients, and matters, using database research and Boolean techniques to surface relevant relationships.

* Vet all requests entering the department, including matter reopenings, new business for existing or new clients, and preliminary checks, resolving missing or inconsistent information before review.
* Evaluate search results and discrepancies methodically, then consolidate findings into clear reports that help attorneys and business stakeholders assess conflicts and manage ethical risk.
* Liaise confidently with attorneys and business representatives by email, telephone, and in person to obtain, clarify, and validate information needed for client and matter intake.
* Prioritize urgent and competing requests in a time\-sensitive environment, maintaining quality, responsiveness, and follow\-through without compromising accuracy or compliance requirements.
* Support the integrity of the conflicts database by applying consistent data standards, documenting updates, and entering general client information after new business approval.
* Participate in scheduled after\-hours or weekend projects and rotational remote on\-call shifts to maintain dependable conflicts support across global teams and deadlines.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Hands\-on experience conducting legal conflict searches, business intake, and conflicts database reviews, with strong attention to detail, accuracy, documentation quality, and ethical risk awareness.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the confidence to engage attorneys and business stakeholders at different levels with clarity, professionalism, and customer\-service orientation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word, plus practical ability to use Boolean search operators and techniques for structured information retrieval.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Prior experience in a law firm, legal department, or professional\-services environment where confidentiality, compliance, and rapid response were essential to daily operations.
* Direct experience with conflicts checking, related\-party research, engagement databases, matter management, or legal business\-intake workflows will help you contribute quickly.
* Familiarity with ABA mandates, conflicts\-of\-interest controls, and ethical risk management is advantageous for evaluating search results and escalating potential concerns appropriately.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Four to six years of experience, including at least three years in a legal, law\-firm, or legal department environment, with conflicts checking or legal intake exposure preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, urgent requests, follow\-ups, and time\-sensitive deadlines while preserving thoroughness, quality, and data integrity.
* A methodical problem\-solving approach that helps you investigate discrepancies, distinguish relevant relationships, and escalate issues with practical recommendations and complete supporting information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, enabling confident interaction with attorneys, business representatives, and colleagues through email, telephone, and in\-person collaboration.
* Strong organization, ownership, and attention to detail, with the judgment to handle confidential information and the discipline to maintain reliable database records.
* A customer\-service mindset and willingness to support scheduled after\-hours or weekend work and rotational on\-call coverage when global business needs require it.
* Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, Word, Boolean search techniques, and structured database research, combined with genuine commitment to compliance and conflicts\-of\-interest controls.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a rapidly scaling India capability center that works alongside global case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership, giving legal operations professionals exposure beyond traditional back\-office support.
* Build expertise in conflicts management, ethical risk, and global business intake while collaborating with attorneys and stakeholders across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
* Grow in a meritocratic culture that combines entrepreneurial ownership, continuous learning, on\-the\-job development, and meaningful opportunities to expand your professional capabilities.
* Contribute to a firm where integrity, quality, objectivity, inclusive diversity, and personal reward guide how teams work and how individual impact is recognized.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A structured performance development process, continuous learning, and on\-the\-job training designed to support professional growth and career progression.
* Exposure to global teams, diverse industries, and complex client\-delivery environments within a rapidly growing 1,000\+ member India capability center.
* An entrepreneurial and collaborative culture that values independent thinking, meaningful ownership, inclusion, and practical impact.
* Benefits and well\-being resources that support employees’ professional development and personal journey.

title: Assistant Manager – India Control
description:
Management Level
   

  

 G
   

  

 EQ Retirement Solutions is transforming the retirement and pensions markets with leading administration and technology solutions. With over 1200 employees globally, 189 years of knowledge and 11 million pension scheme members and policyholders, we are here to help people plan for a confident financial future by delivering innovative, reliable and customer\-focused retirement services. Our teams are driven by a shared commitment to excellence, collaboration and making a real impact to the lives of our clients and customers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Assistant Manager – India Control**
 The Assistant Manager – India Control is responsible for supporting the maintenance of a robust financial control, compliance, and governance framework across the India Finance organisation. Working under the leadership of the Head of Shared Services, the role ensures effective execution of statutory compliance, tax filings, payroll controls, balance sheet governance, audit activities, and entity\-level financial controls.
   

  

 The role acts as a key coordinator between Finance, Shared Services, external auditors, tax authorities, regulatory bodies, payroll providers, and business stakeholders to ensure that the organisation meets its statutory, financial, and compliance obligations. The position also supports accurate financial reporting, strengthens internal controls, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance governance, reduce risk, and improve operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical accounting and compliance knowledge, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a controlled and timely manner. They will be proactive, analytical, and committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy, integrity, and compliance.
   

  

**Core Duties/Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:
   

  

**Financial Controls \& Compliance**
* Support the Head of Shared Services in maintaining a robust financial control and governance framework across India operations.
* Perform control monitoring, compliance reviews, and risk assessments, supporting remediation of identified control gaps.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, accounting standards, delegated authorities, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to governance, business continuity, and risk management initiatives.


**Tax \& Statutory Compliance \- India**
* Ensure compliance with IFRS and local statutory accounting requirements, supporting accurate financial reporting and governance.
* Manage GST refund claims and export incentive submissions, ensuring timely recovery of eligible benefits.
* Oversee TDS and GST payments, ensuring accurate calculations and timely remittance to authorities, as well filing of returns.
* Manage SEZ and STPI compliance filings, ensuring adherence to applicable regulations and reporting obligations.
* Coordinate secretarial compliance\-related payments and statutory filings in partnership with Company Secretaries and external advisors.
* Maintain controls over MSME reporting requirements, including preparation, validation, and timely filing of MSME returns.
* Support tax audits, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments, ensuring timely resolution of queries and findings.
* Monitor regulatory developments and maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of local accounting, tax, and statutory requirements.


**Audit \& Regulatory Management**
* Coordinate internal and external audits, including preparation of supporting documentation and management of audit actions.
* Support compliance reviews, regulatory inspections, and governance assessments.
* Liaise with auditors, advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of audit and compliance matters.


**Balance Sheet Controls \& Financial Integrity**
* Perform balance sheet reviews, reconciliations, and control account monitoring to ensure financial integrity.
* Support Month\-End, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities, including intercompany and cost allocation processes.
* Investigate and resolve accounting exceptions, reconciliation issues, and control weaknesses.


**Budget, MIS \& Treasury Support**
* Support budgeting and forecasting activities.
* Monitor and analyse cash variances and treasury\-related transactions.
* Provide financial analysis and management information reporting.
* Partner with FP\&A and business teams to support decision\-making through accurate financial insights.


**Payroll Accounting \& Controls**
* Review payroll calculations and related accounting entries for India region.
* Perform payroll reconciliations and balance sheet substantiation.
* Investigate and resolve payroll\-related queries and exceptions.
* Ensure payroll processes comply with company policies and statutory requirements.


**Continuous Improvement \& Operational Excellence**
* Drive process improvements, control enhancements, standardisation, and automation initiatives.
* Support Finance transformation and Shared Services improvement programmes.
* Promote a culture of compliance, accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**
 The successful candidate will demonstrate the following experience skills and behaviours:
   

  

**EXPERIENCE:**
* 5\-8 years of progressive experience in Finance, Accounting, Controls, Audit, Compliance, Payroll, or Shared Services operations.
* Proven experience managing statutory audits, tax compliance, regulatory filings, and financial controls.
* Experience in payroll accounting, reconciliations, journal preparation, and Month\-End close activities.
* Demonstrated ability to identify risks, strengthen controls, and drive process improvements within a finance environment.
* Experience working within a multinational organisation or Shared Services environment would be advantageous.


**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS:**
* MBA (Finance) or Postgraduate qualification in Finance, Accounting, or Business Management or CA \\ CMA inter or equivalent
* Strong working knowledge of Indian accounting standards, taxation, statutory compliance, payroll accounting, and financial controls.


**SKILLS:**
* Fluent English: written and spoken.
* Proven Leadership abilities and team working
* Excellent organizational, communication and planning skills
* Professional, credible individual with an ability to influence peers, superiors and subordinates
* Adaptable with an ability to change direction and priorities if required

title: Vice President, Third Party Risk Management Lead - Philippines Market
description:
The Third‑Party Risk Management Lead is accountable for driving the execution of Citi’s TPM program for the Philippines market, ensuring alignment with Group policies and compliance with applicable local regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Procurement and Third\-Party Management (P\&TPM) is responsible for procuring products and services for Citigroup and manages the risk associated with Citi's use of and reliance upon third party relationships, including outsourced arrangements, across all business lines and locations. P\&TPM defines and oversees the implementation of policies and standards that provide controls to assess and manage risk related to Citi's third\-party relationships and outsourcing arrangements. The goal of P\&TPM is to support Citi's selection and management of third\-parties capable of providing products and services in a safe and sound manner and at a reasonable cost and to manage the risk associated with third parties.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Lead and drive Third Party Risk Management regime for Citi Philippines, ensuring effective compliance to local third\-party and outsourcing regulations, including Citi’s Global policies and standards.
* Drive root cause analysis of third\-party risk issues and work with business and in\-business risk and control, on effective correction action plans.
* Partner with businesses, including Chief Country Officer and Head of Operations, to properly assess broader impact, and require implementation of correct action plans where broader applications were identified.
* Assess the effectiveness of the current TPM practices and lead enhancement opportunities to standards and procedures, control, and governance processes, to help ensure sustainability and optimization of the Philippines TPM landscape.
* Leverage change management approaches and methods, assess capacity and readiness for change. Use the assessment to work with P\&TPM and business leaders to establish implementation plan for process improvement/transformation.
* Partner in supporting updates, reviews and request fulfilment to Independent Operational Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Audit and Regulators.
* Administer and lead the Country committee/forum as per charter and ensure that all discussions/actions are documented and communicated to all members.
* Responsible in maintaining country TPM procedure and ensure both Global policies and standards, and Local Regulation requirement are met. This includes overseeing and maintaining of local third\-party inventory, and the end\-to\-end life cycle of TPM (not limited to onboarding assessment, continuous monitoring, termination process).
* The successful candidate must be able to work in accordance with Philippines business hours to effectively support local stakeholders and regulatory requirements


**Qualifications:**
* 10\+ years of experience in third\-party risk management, operational risk or related field within the Banking or Financial Services sector.
* In\-depth knowledge of TPRM frameworks, risk management methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong ability in analyzing complex risks, identifying root causes and develop practical solutions. Detailed\-oriented with a structured and logical approach to problem\-solving.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with proven ability to build strong relationships across functions, and skilled in influencing and collaborating with stakeholders at all levels.
* Solid understanding of governance frameworks and experience in supporting audits and regulatory reviews.
* Proactive, self\-driven and capable of managing multiple priorities in fast\-paced setting.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience, potentially Masters degree.

title: Asset Manager
description:
Step into the role of Asset Manager at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct.
   

  

 You will focus on supporting and overseeing credit documentation and managing the execution of lending transactions while ensuring compliance with legal and operational requirements. The role requires strong stakeholder engagement, proactive coordination with clients and business teams, and driving deals to closure through effective communication and decision making within Barclays.
   

  

 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:
   

  

  

* Review and manage credit and legal documentation to support smooth execution of lending transactions.
* Coordinate with clients, legal teams, and internal stakeholders to obtain necessary approvals and resolve documentation related queries.
* Analyse legal drafts and ensure alignment with business, regulatory, and operational requirements.
* Identify risks, escalate issues appropriately, and ensure all processes are completed within agreed timelines.
* Act as a key point of contact for stakeholders, providing updates and driving timely closure of deals.


**Desirable Skills Set**
* Strong experience in credit documentation and lending operations.
* Good understanding of legal terminology, contracts, and documentation review processes.
* Assertive personality with strong negotiation and problem\-solving abilities..
* Excellent stakeholder management, client handling, and communication skills.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented mindset with a strong focus on execution and delivery.


 You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Chennai.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support Wholesale Lending with day\-to\-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Support with day\-to\-day Wholesale Lending initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution through lending technical expertise.
* Monitoring the bank’s lending operations to ensure that they are conducted in an efficient and effective manner and comply with relevant regulatory requirements.
* Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate Wholesale Lending processes.
* Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations for change in Wholesale Lending processes.
* Development and implementation of Wholesale Lending procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.
* Development of reports and presentations on Wholesale Lending performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in Wholesale Lending Services.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Deputy General Manager - Commercial Contract
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O\&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 This position is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end management of contracts, ensuring efficient collections, maintaining compliance, managing LC processes, coordinating commercial operations, and facilitating financial transactions while fostering customer satisfaction and adherence to contractual terms.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 He will lead the end\-to\-end commercial function for a large\-scale coal trading business, ensuring seamless execution of domestic and international coal transactions. The role is responsible for contract management, Letter of Credit (LC) operations, trade finance, documentation, commercial risk management, customer and supplier settlements, statutory compliance, shipment execution, MIS reporting, and process automation. The incumbent will play a critical role in safeguarding commercial interests, , mitigating contractual and financial risks, and driving operational excellence across the coal value chain.
   

  

* Commercial Strategy \& Business Governance
* Lead the commercial operations function for domestic and international coal trading businesses.
* Develop commercial strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives and market dynamics.
* Ensure adherence to corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and internal control frameworks.
* Contract Management \& Commercial Risk
* Lead drafting, review, negotiation, and execution of coal procurement and sales contracts.
* Evaluate and approve contract terms relating to pricing, quantity, quality specifications, payment terms, delivery conditions, penalties, and force majeure provisions.
* Identify commercial, contractual, legal, and operational risks and recommend mitigation measures.
* Ensure compliance with Incoterms, international trade regulations, and corporate contracting standards.
* Manage contract deviations, amendments, claims, disputes, arbitration matters, and contract closures.
* Coordinate with Legal, Marketing, Operations, and Finance teams for contract governance and compliance.
* Letter of Credit (LC) \& Trade Finance Management
* Oversee opening, amendment, negotiation, and closure of Domestic and International Letters of Credit.
* Ensure timely receipt of customer LCs and issuance of supplier LCs as per contractual requirements.
* Review LC clauses for compliance with UCP 600, ISBP guidelines, banking regulations, and contractual obligations.
* Drive LC discounting, bill negotiation, collection arrangements, and trade finance optimization.
* Liaise with banks for LC confirmation, discounting, acceptance, reimbursement, and settlement processes.
* Monitor bank guarantees, performance guarantees, standby LCs, and other trade finance instruments.
* Manage discrepancies in shipping and banking documents to ensure timely realization of funds.


**Documentation \& Shipment Execution**
* Ensure preparation, verification, and control of all trade\-related documentation.
* Ensure timely document presentation for payment realization and shipment release.


**Receivables, Collections \& Working Capital Management**
* Drive collection of customer receivables within agreed credit terms.
* Monitor exposure limits, debtor aging, credit utilization, and overdue accounts.
* Ensure timely collection of cargo value, premiums, penalties, interest charges, and logistics\-related recoveries.
* Strengthening commercial controls to prevent revenue leakage and financial exposure.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, suppliers, banks, and strategic stakeholders.
* Drive service excellence and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Lead and manage cross\-functional commercial teams.
* Develop high\-performance culture through coaching, mentoring, and capability development.


**Others**
**Key Stakeholders Internal:**
* Marketing
* Operations
* Finance and accounting
* Legal
* Logistics
* Customs


**Key Stakeholders External**
* 
* Customers
* Suppliers/ Vendors
* External Agencies (Government, Banking, Agents, etc.)
* Third party service providers


**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, or related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM (Finance, Operations, International Business) preferred.
* Additional certifications in Trade Finance, International Trade, Commercial Management, or Contract Management will be preferred.


**Experience**
* 10\-12 years of experience in Coal Trading, Commodities Trading, Mining, Energy, Metals, or Bulk Cargo industries.
* Proven experience in managing large\-value domestic and international trading transactions.
* Extensive exposure to commercial operations, contract management, LC operations, trade finance, documentation, logistics, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience handling multiple stakeholders including customers, suppliers, banks, legal teams, shipping lines, customs authorities, and government agencies.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Stay in Compliance Lead – GCS**


**Job Summary:**



The Stay In Compliance Lead within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) is responsible for defining, governing, and driving the global network infrastructure compliance strategy to ensure network devices remain current, secure, and aligned with supported hardware and software standards. The role is responsible for maintaining the software and hardware currency of network infrastructure across WAN, LAN, WiFi, SD\-WAN, telephony, and related connectivity platforms by leading regular software upgrades, security patching, hardware refresh governance, and configuration remediation activities.



The position proactively identifies and mitigates security risks by leveraging OEM tools, vulnerability intelligence platforms, and security advisories to assess the exposure of network infrastructure to emerging threats and vulnerabilities. Working closely with I\&O Stay in Compliance (SIC), Business Relationship Managers (BRMs), OSTS, Network Engineering, Network Operations, Product Owners, and vendor partners, the role drives GCS enterprise\-wide compliance initiatives, ensures timely execution of remediation activities, and strengthens the organization's overall network security posture. The Stay In Compliance Lead serves as the central authority for network lifecycle governance, vulnerability management, compliance reporting, and risk reduction across the global connectivity estate.

  


**Job Description**


* Own and lead the Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) vulnerability management program, ensuring identification, assessment, prioritisation, remediation, and reporting of security vulnerabilities across the entire GCS product portfolio.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive vulnerability remediation and risk management roadmap, leveraging data\-driven insights, analytics, and risk\-based prioritisation to reduce overall security exposure.
* Establish and execute Global Vulnerability Management compliance plans across WAN, LAN, WiFi, SD\-WAN, Telephony, NAC, Internet Edge, and associated network infrastructure platforms.
* Drive end\-to\-end remediation governance for critical, high, and medium\-risk vulnerabilities, ensuring timely closure or approved risk exceptions in accordance with business and security requirements.
* Maintain accountability for compliance against remediation SLAs and security standards established by Information Security, tracking progress, ageing, and compliance performance across the GCS estate.
* Partner with Information Security, Product Owners, Network Engineering, Network Operations, Service Management, OSTS, BRMs, and other stakeholders to ensure effective execution of security remediation activities.
* Define, implement, and continuously enhance policies, standards, processes, and procedures governing vulnerability management, software currency, hardware lifecycle compliance, and security remediation activities.
* Establish and maintain a robust controls framework that ensures effective governance, auditability, compliance monitoring, and risk management across GCS services.
* Collaborate closely with Information Security and Enterprise Technology stakeholders to lead GCS participation in Critical Vulnerability Response Plan (CVRP) exercises and enterprise\-wide cyber response activities.
* Continuously monitor OEM advisories, vulnerability intelligence feeds, security bulletins, and threat intelligence platforms to identify risks impacting GCS infrastructure and services.
* Partner with vendors and OEMs to assess the impact of emerging security threats, recommended mitigations, software defects, and lifecycle\-related risks.
* Drive execution of critical security patching, emergency remediation activities, and infrastructure upgrades to reduce organisational risk exposure.
* Act as the primary GCS representative within the Intelligent Operations Center (IOC) for security vulnerability management, remediation coordination, and risk response activities.
* Review, challenge, and validate risk exception requests, ensuring technical justification, compensating controls, and business impact assessments are appropriately documented before approval.
* Provide technical guidance and risk advisory support to leadership teams, product owners, and business stakeholders regarding vulnerability remediation strategies and compliance obligations.
* Develop, maintain, and publish executive dashboards, scorecards, and management reports covering vulnerability exposure, remediation progress, security compliance, software currency, hardware currency, and risk posture across GCS.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), risk indicators (KRIs), remediation targets, and compliance metrics to measure programme effectiveness.
* Drive automation and continuous process improvement initiatives across vulnerability assessment, remediation tracking, software upgrades, patch management, compliance reporting, and IOC operational activities.
* Partner with Service Management teams to ensure all security remediation activities adhere to established governance, change management, ITSM, and operational compliance requirements.
* Own stakeholder communications related to security vulnerabilities, remediation plans, compliance risks, maintenance activities, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Lead incident\-related vulnerability remediation activities, ensuring effective coordination across technical teams and timely communication to stakeholders.
* Lead and manage the GCS Stay In Compliance team, ensuring clear accountability, ownership, and execution of vulnerability management and remediation activities.

  


**Knowledge \& Competencies Required:**


* Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies including routing, switching, wireless, SD\-WAN, telephony, NAC, DNS, DHCP, and network security platforms.
* Strong expertise in vulnerability management, network security compliance, patch management, and infrastructure lifecycle governance.
* Experience working with OEM security advisory tools and vulnerability management platforms such as Cisco PSIRT, Meraki, Arista, Palo Alto, Versa, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, Tenable, Qualys, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of security frameworks, risk management methodologies, and infrastructure hardening principles.
* Proven experience managing software upgrades, firmware lifecycle programs, and security remediation initiatives.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess business risk, prioritize remediation activities, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Experience developing compliance dashboards, executive reporting, and operational metrics.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and coordinate across technology, security, vendor, and business teams.
* Knowledge of infrastructure lifecycle management, EOL/EOS governance, and technology refresh planning.
* Experience leveraging automation and AI\-driven capabilities to enhance compliance monitoring and remediation processes.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical risks to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to lead complex global initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, regions, and vendor organizations.
* Demonstrated leadership capability with a proactive, outcome\-driven, and risk\-focused approach.

  


**Job Requirements:**


**Education:**



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline

  


**Experience:**



Minimum of 12 years of experience in Network technology support.

  


**Certification Requirements:**



CCNP preferred, Certification on Versa or CCIE is value add.

description:
**About Us:** 




 Tata Electronics is a leading force in India’s growing electronics and semiconductor manufacturing industry, backed by the trusted legacy of the Tata Group. With world\-class facilities across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Gujarat, and Assam, the company is driving innovation and supporting the nation’s “Make in India” vision. Today, Tata Electronics employs around 70,000 people and is rapidly expanding its footprint to shape the future of high\-tech manufacturing.
 



**TEPS Chennai** 
 , located in
 **Mahindra World City** 
 , is one of the flagship facilities of Tata Electronics, with a workforce of
 **10,000\+ employees** 
 . Known for its exceptional operational efficiency and high\-performance culture, the plant consistently delivers excellence in quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction. Driven by a motivated and passionate workforce, TEPS Chennai fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement. More than a manufacturing facility, it is a center of growth, learning, and opportunity—contributing significantly to Tata Electronics’ vision of building a globally competitive and technologically advanced India.
 



  




* **Department \- Human Resources**
* **Division \- Employee Relations**
* **Job Title \- Statutory \& Compliance Lead**
* **Job Level \- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager**
* **Location \- Chennai**
* **Reporting To \- Plant ER Lead**



  





**Job Specifications** 




  





**Desired Educational Background** 



* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Social Work, or a related field is required.
* Master's degree in human resources, Labor Welfare, Labor law or Employee Relations is preferred.
* Certification in Labor laws, compliance regulations, ER and IR is preferred



**Desired Experience** 



* 7\-10 years of experience in Statutory and Labor Compliance
* Working experience in manufacturing organization (Plant Location).
* Experience in electronic manufacturing or related industries is preferred.
* Experience in green field assignments or setting up of processes, systems, policies and implementation of rollouts is an added advantage
* Experience of working with a blue\-collared (on\-roll \& contract) or a unionized workforce is preferred



**Desired Certifications** 



* Additional certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, HR Systems, Employee Relations, and POSH will be considered an added advantage.



  





**What we are looking for:** 




**Role Purpose:** 
 The Statutory \& Labor Compliance Lead is a key individual contributor responsible for ensuring the organization's compliance with all applicable labor laws, statutory regulations, and legal requirements while mitigating compliance, legal, and operational risks. Operating at the intersection of governance, risk management, and business continuity, the Statutory \& Labour Compliance Lead drives compliance excellence through proactive compliance monitoring, implementation of statutory requirements, labour law compliance, contractor compliance governance, internal and external audits, customer audits, regulatory engagement, and policy deployment. The role ensures timely statutory filings, audit readiness, adherence to labour legislation, and effective closure of compliance observations while fostering a culture of integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Who is it for?** 
 This is more than a compliance role—it's an opportunity to build a culture of integrity, governance, and operational excellence. If you're passionate about labor laws, regulatory compliance, and creating systems that enable sustainable business growth, this role is for you. You'll partner with business leaders, customers, regulatory authorities, and cross\-functional teams to drive audit readiness, strengthen compliance frameworks, and mitigate organizational risks. If you thrive in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment and enjoy turning regulatory requirements into practical business solutions, you'll make a meaningful impact in this role.
 



  





**What we Expect you to Bring:** 



* A people\-first mindset with strong shop\-floor presence and hands\-on execution.
* Ability to build trust, credibility, and meaningful relationships across all workforce segments.
* Strong expertise in Labor Codes, Central and State Labor Laws, Factory Regulations, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Analytical and risk assessment skills with the ability to identify compliance gaps and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Sound knowledge of Contract Labor Management, contractor compliance, and vendor governance.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to develop compliance dashboards, reports, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Curiosity and learning agility to interpret changing legal requirements and translate them into practical business processes.
* Expertise in handling Customer, Internal and External Audits.
* Experience in liaising with Government Authorities such as Labor Department, Factory Inspectorate, EPFO, ESIC etc.,
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic manufacturing environment while managing multiple compliance priorities.



  





**What you will get:** 



* Be a part of a TATA enterprise that’s reshaping India’s Global Electronics Manufacturing story
* A seat at the table in shaping a future\-ready manufacturing powerhouse
* Build a plant, a culture and legacy, not just a function
* The chance to build a culture of trust, fairness, and inclusion while making a measurable business impact.
* Work alongside experienced business leaders and HR professionals on transformational initiatives.
* Freedom to experiment, build and grow
* An environment that values initiative, ownership, and people\-impact



  





**Important Considerations:** 



1. This role is based at the plant (factory). It follows a six\-day workweek and will be a 100% work from office role
2. The plant operates 24X7, flexibility to work in shifts based on business or operational requirements
3. Prior experience of managing plant / shop floor workforce is preferred
4. Ability to communicate in English and Tamil is essential



  





**Contribution areas\- Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Statutory \& Labor Compliance Governance** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable Central \& State Labour Laws, Factory Regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Drive implementation of Labour Codes, legal amendments, and compliance policies across the organization.
* Develop and strengthen compliance frameworks, SOPs, and governance mechanisms.
* Monitor compliance performance through periodic reviews and dashboards.



**Audit \& Regulatory Readiness:** 



* Lead customer, internal, external, and statutory audits while ensuring continuous audit readiness.
* Manage regulatory inspections and coordinate timely closure of audit observations through CAPA.
* Maintain statutory registers, licenses, records, and documentation in line with legal requirements.
* Ensure monthly and annual customer audit compliance by tracking action plans and driving timely closure of observations.



**Contractor \& Vendor Compliance:** 



* Ensure statutory compliance of contractors and vendors in line with applicable labour laws.
* Conduct periodic compliance reviews and identify risks across the contractor ecosystem.
* Drive corrective actions to strengthen contractor governance and compliance maturity.



**Compliance Risk \& Legal Governance** 



* Identify and mitigate statutory, regulatory, and compliance risks.
* Monitor legislative changes and assess business impact.
* Lead compliance investigations, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive measures.
* Provide compliance insights and reports to leadership for informed decision\-making.



**Stakeholder \& Regulatory Engagement** 



* Build and maintain effective relationships with government authorities, customers, certification bodies, and external auditors.
* Provide expert guidance to HR, Operations, EHS, Procurement, and business leaders on statutory compliance matters.
* Support customer due diligence, regulatory submissions, and timely renewal of statutory licenses and approvals.



**External Interfaces** 



* **Government Agencies:** 
 Liaise with government agencies regarding employment law compliance audits or investigations.
* **Clients/ Customer:** 
 Prepare, review and present key talent metrics and insights with the clients during client visits and audits
* **Vendors:** 
 Continually inspect, provide feedback and hold vendors accountable for providing services that meet the agreed standards



**Internal Interface** 



* **HR Team:** 
 Partner to ensure compliance with labor laws, statutory documentation, employee records, contractor compliance, and implementation of labor law amendments.
* **Plant Operations:** 
 Collaborate to ensure shop\-floor operations comply with statutory requirements related to working hours, contractor deployment, welfare provisions, and regulatory standards.
* **EHS (Environment, Health \& Safety):** 
 Coordinate to ensure compliance with the Factories Act, occupational health \& safety regulations, statutory inspections, and corrective actions.
* **Legal Department:** 
 Legal Department: Consult on labor law interpretations, regulatory notices, compliance risks, government inspections, litigation support, and legal compliance requirements.








 Regards
 



 Human Resources

**Job Description**

**Role Purpose**




 Drive commercial excellence across large\-scale Asia projects in
 **infrastructure, energy, and natural resources** 
 , ensuring robust contract strategy, disciplined cost control, and proactive risk management. You will lead negotiations for complex construction agreements, manage claims and disputes, and establish governance frameworks that protect margins and enable successful delivery of multi\-billion\-dollar projects.
   

  





**Strategic Imperative**




 Transform commercial and contractual rigor into a strategic advantage: standardize contract playbooks, enforce risk allocation discipline (FIDIC/NEC/local forms), lead high\-value negotiations, and institutionalize lessons learned to strengthen delivery certainty and profitability across diverse Asia markets.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\) Commercial Strategy \& Planning**



* Develop and execute commercial strategies for major infrastructure and energy projects across Asia.
* Define procurement approaches for EPC, EPCM, Design \& Build, and other bespoke agreements to regional market conditions.
* Establish and maintain contract playbooks and negotiation guidelines to ensure consistency and best practice.



**2\) Contracting \& Negotiations**



* Lead negotiations for large\-scale construction agreements, ensuring optimal risk allocation and commercial value.
* Integrate technical and execution constraints into enforceable contractual terms, including LDs, performance guarantees, and incentive mechanisms.
* Collaborate with Legal and Project Delivery teams to ensure contracts are executable and aligned with delivery capabilities.



**3\) Cost Management \& Financial Control**



* Oversee project budgets, forecasts, and cash flow; implement rigorous change control processes.
* Drive value engineering initiatives and monitor commitments against approved budgets.
* Provide executive\-level reporting on commercial exposure and recovery strategies.



**4\) Risk \& Compliance**



* Identify and mitigate commercial, legal, and execution risks across multi\-jurisdictional projects.
* Apply international and regional contract standards (FIDIC, NEC, local forms) and ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks.
* Conduct post\-project reviews to capture lessons learned and improve future contracting strategies.



**5\) Claims \& Dispute Management**



* Lead complex variation and extension\-of\-time claims, ensuring timely resolution and margin protection.
* Manage dispute avoidance and resolution boards (DAB/DRB) and negotiate settlement agreements where necessary.
* Implement claims governance and early\-warning systems to minimize escalation.



**6\) Stakeholder \& Partner Engagement**



* Act as the senior commercial representative with clients, contractors, lenders, and government authorities.
* Build strong relationships to facilitate approvals, resolve issues, and secure successful project outcomes.



**7\) Leadership \& Team Development**



* Mentor and develop Commercial Managers and Analysts; foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.



 Promote collaboration across Project Delivery, Engineering, Legal, and Finance teams
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Essential**



* 10–15\+ years’ experience in commercial management for major infrastructure, energy, or natural resource projects.

title: Data Protection Officer
description:
**Primary Purpose** 




 To own, maintain and improve our data protection and privacy compliance framework, ensuring lawful, fair and transparent processing of personal data across our processing sites in the UK, EU, India, Philippines, US and Canada.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities:** 




 The Data Protection Officer is responsible for proactively managing and improving our data protection compliance framework, driving privacy accountability and lawful processing across the organisation, partnering with IT, Operations, Engineering, HR, Procurement and business stakeholders to embed practical data protection controls and support compliant growth.
 


* Own and maintain the data protection governance framework, including policies, standards, procedures and supporting documentation.
* Maintain and manage the Record of Processing Activities (ROPA), ensuring processing activities, data flows, systems, suppliers and international transfers are accurately documented and kept up to date.
* Lead and produce Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs), EU Standard Contract Clauses (SCC) and other privacy risk assessments for new and changed processing activities and transfers.
* Review, negotiate and advise on client and supplier data processing agreements (DPAs), privacy clauses and international data transfer provisions.
* Monitor compliance with applicable privacy and data protection legislation across our processing sites in the UK, EU, India, Philippines, US and Canada, escalating gaps and driving remediation actions.
* Provide practical guidance on lawful bases for processing, data subject rights, retention, minimisation, privacy by design and cross\-border transfers.
* Support the management of personal data breaches, including triage, risk assessment, notification decision\-making, client communications and post\-incident review.
* Work with supplier owners and procurement teams to assess third\-party privacy risk and ensure appropriate due diligence and contractual controls are in place.
* Develop and deliver data protection training and awareness to employees and support responses to client privacy questionnaires, audits and compliance requests.
* Define and report privacy KPIs, incidents, risks, audit findings and action plans to senior leadership, while working with IT, Operations, Engineering and wider business units to identify risks and scale good practice.



  





**Professional skills/ experience:** 



* 5\+ years in data protection, privacy compliance or information governance with hands\-on responsibility for operational privacy activities.
* Proven experience reviewing and negotiating client and supplier DPAs and advising on practical contractual privacy requirements.
* Strong experience producing DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs and supporting data subject rights, retention and international transfer compliance.
* Working knowledge of UK GDPR, EU GDPR and broader international privacy requirements across the UK, EU, India, Philippines, US and Canada.
* Professional certification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, EU GDPR Practitioner or equivalent privacy qualification desirable.
* Able to translate privacy risk into business impact and influence stakeholders at all levels.



  





**Personal Qualities** 



* Problem solver.
* Great with people, can build trust and rapport across the entire organisation.
* Good communicator with clients and internally.
* Team Player commitment and flexible.
* Ability to prioritise and quickly resolve issues.
* Attention to detail.
